Beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
stats: You and your minions deal 50% increased melee damage

Druid.name: Druid
stats: When leaving a transformed state, you gain 70% damage reduction for 2 seconds

Shaman.name: Shaman
stats: +50% elemental resistance while you control a totem

srtor-16.name: Sharp Claws
description: Your raptor deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

srtor-12.name: Scent of Blood
description: Your raptor deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

srtor-23.name: Predator
description: Your raptor has additional critical strike chance.
reminderText: Base critical strike chance is 5%

srtor-20.name: Cornered
description: Your raptor deals more damage for each percent of its missing health (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to 50% missing health.
reminderText: At 2 points, this node gives the Raptor 198% more damage while it is at 1% health.

srtor-30.name: Brutal Shredding
description: Your raptor has additional critical strike multiplier, and its attacks have a chance to shred armor on hit.

srtor-21.name: Broken Tooth
stats: 5% Percent Of Current Health Lost On Melee Attack Above 50%
description: Your raptor has increased melee attack speed, but loses 5% of its current health with each attack while above 50% of maximum health.

srtor-15.name: Tear Flesh
description: Your raptor's melee attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

srtor-2.name: Iridescent Plumage
description: Your raptor has additional elemental resistance and have additional dodge chance.

srtor-6.name: Clever Girl
description: Your raptor has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities.

srtor-11.name: Taste for Flesh
description: Your raptor has increased attack and cast speed. This effect is doubled if it has killed an enemy in the past 4 seconds.

srtor-28.name: Menacing Aura
description: While your raptor is {Rampaging}, its hits instantly kill enemies below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

srtor-3.name: Screech
description: Your raptor gains the ability to {Screech} at enemies, dealing damage and shredding their physical resistance. Screech has an 8 second cooldown.
reminderText: The damage and resistance shred of Screech can be converted by {Volcanic Adaptation}.

srtor-25.name: Eager
description: {Rampage} costs less mana.

srtor-17.name: Acidic Bile
description: Your raptor's attacks have a chance to inflict blind, poison, and slow on hit.
reminderText: Blinded enemies have 50% less critical hit chance and are less accurate at range. Does not stack.

srtor-19.name: Dripping Blood
stats: 25% Chance On Hit To Double Bleed Speed
description: When your raptor hits an enemy, bleeds on that enemy have a 25% chance to double in speed.

srtor-4.name: Earsplitting Roar
description: {Screech}'s cooldown is reduced, and it causes enemies it hits to {Bleed}.

srtor-24.name: Vexation
description: {Rampage}'s duration is increased.

srtor-26.name: Challenger
stats: Raptor Rampages Near Rares And Bosses
description: Your raptor uses {Rampage} if it encounters a boss or rare enemy, if it is able to. This sets Rampage to 50% of its normal cooldown.

srtor-7.name: Brilliant Display
stats: Raptor Reduces Other Companion Cooldowns Every 8 Seconds
description: Your raptor automatically reduces the cooldown of your other companions' activatable abilities by 3 seconds. This effect has an 8 second cooldown.
reminderText: Your Raptor's increased cooldown recovery speed applies to the cooldown of this effect.

srtor-27.name: Primal Rage
description: {Rampage} also grants your raptor less damage taken for the duration.

srtor-9.name: Volcanic Adaptation
description:
Your raptor becomes a {Dragon Raptor}. The base physical damage of your raptor's melee attacks are converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

Your raptor gains the {Fire Breath} ability, dealing spell fire damage over time with an 8 second cooldown.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for your raptor, and all effects in the tree related to bleed now depend on ignite.

srtor-10.name: Molten Lungs
description: {Fire Breath}'s cooldown is reduced, and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

srtor-8.name: Razor Wings
description: Your raptor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect for its abilities.

srtor-22.name: Vicious Rampage
description: Your raptor gains increased effect from {Rampage}.
reminderText: Does not increase the size gain from Rampage.

srtor-13.name: In for the Kill
stats: 1% Chance per Bleed for Haste on Enemy Death
description: When a bleeding enemy dies within 12 meters, your raptor has a chance per stack of bleed on that enemy to gain Haste for 3 seconds.

srtor-29.name: Hot Streak
description: {Rampage} also resets the cooldown of {Fire Breath}.
reminderText: Using a town portal will reset this buff even if you return to the same zone.

srtor-14.name: Ravage
stats: +25% Max More Melee Damage from Bleed
description: Your raptor deals more melee damage per bleed on the enemy (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.

wc57-5.name: Jormun's Wrath
description:
Warcry now freezes enemies instead of stunning them, but it no longer knocks enemies back.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to bleed now depend on Frostbite instead.
reminderText: Physical damage from {Kinetic Scream} is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

wc57-9.name: Frigid Breath
description: Enemies frozen by Warcry take increased damage from hits.

wc57-12.name: Juggernaut
description: You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Warcry.

wc57-22.name: Berserker
stats: +1 Berserk Stacks On Hit While Berserk
description:
You gain the {Berserk} buff for 1.5 seconds when you use Warcry, granting you additional melee damage.

While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.
reminderText: With {Totemic Heart} you gain Berserk when you place the totem.

wc57-10.name: Debilitating Shout
description: Warcry applies one stack of {Frailty} to affected enemies for a short duration.

wc57-29.name: Challenging Might
description: Warcry now also taunts affected enemies for a short duration.
reminderText: This effect does not work if Warcry is used by a totem.

wc57-16.name: Invigorate
description:
Warcry now also restores ally health for the same amount as from {Breath of Eterra}. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

wc57-14.name: Whirlpool
description:
You now cast {Maelstrom} when you use Warcry. 

Maelstrom cast this way costs less mana.

wc57-32.name: Shallow Breath
description: Warcry now has a cooldown of 5 seconds which cannot be reduced by stunning or freezing enemies, but Warcry no longer has a guaranteed stun, freeze, or fear.
reminderText: This cooldown can be affected by other sources of cooldown reduction.

wc57-2.name: Deep Roar
description: Warcry affects a larger area.

wc57-24.name: Brutality
description: {Berserk} has increased duration and additional maximum stacks.
reminderText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

wc57-27.name: Staggering Roar
description: Warcry knocks enemies further back.

wc57-3.name: Battle Cry
description: You and allies affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance for 4 seconds.

wc57-8.name: Heart of Rime
description: Warcry inflicts stacks of {Frostbite} to affected enemies.

wc57-25.name: Bloodthirst
description: {Berserk} now also affects your Raptor and Bear.
reminderText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

wc57-28.name: Apprehend
description: Warcry now pulls enemies instead of knocking them back.
reminderText: Modifiers to knockback distance now affect pull distance.

wc57-33.name: Totemic Heart
description: You now place down a totem for 3 seconds that repeatedly uses Warcry instead of you, but Warcry costs more mana.
reminderText:
Warcry cannot taunt if used by a totem.

When used by a totem Warcry benefits from your minion and totem stats rather than your own stats.

wc57-21.name: Horrifying Cry
stats: +2% Damage to Feared per Berserk Stack
description: Fear inflicted by Warcry lasts longer and each stack of the {Berserk} buff from the Berserker node now also causes you to deal more damage to Feared enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wc57-20.name: Frightful Presence
description: Warcry now fears enemies for 2 seconds instead of stunning them.
reminderText:
Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

This has no effect if you have {Jormun's Wrath}.

wc57-30.name: Kinetic Scream
description: Warcry now hits enemies and deals spell physical damage.
reminderText: Added spell damage now applies to Warcry at 200% effectiveness.

wc57-7.name: Bringer of Winter
description: You and your cold minions affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance and additional chill chance for 4 seconds.
reminderText: As an example if you take the {Tundra Stalkers} on your {Summon Wolf's} tree, it would gain the cold tag and be considered a cold minion.

wc57-19.name: Raging Frenzy
description: You gain {Frenzy} for the same duration as you have Haste from {Hastily Advance}.

wc57-31.name: Eviscerating Howl
description: Warcry causes enemies to bleed.

wc57-11.name: Toxic Companions
description: For 4 seconds after using Warcry, your {Wolves} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and your {Scorpion} has a chance to poison enemies.

wc57-13.name: Breath of Eterra
description:
Warcry now also restores your health. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

wc57-6.name: Frost Claw
description: You and allies affected by Warcry deal increased cold damage for 4 seconds.

wc57-4.name: Ferocity
description:
While Warcry is on cooldown, your critical strikes have a chance to use Warcry for you. 

This effect can only happen once per direct Warcry use, and it will reset the cooldown.

wc57-26.name: Fury Strikes
description: {Berserk} now also grants you increased attack speed per stack of Berserk up to a maximum.
reminderText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

wc57-18.name: Energized Charge
description: Warcry costs less mana and {Haste} gained from {Hastily Advance} lasts longer.

wc57-17.name: Hastily Advance
description: If Warcry hits at least one enemy, you gain {Haste} for 1 second.

wc57-15.name: Purging Shout
description: Warcry now cleanses negative ailments on you.

wc57-0.name: Warcry
description: Unleash a mighty roar that stuns and knocks back nearby enemies.

st31et-18.name: Eye of the Viper
description: Serpent Strike's critical strikes deal more damage.

st31et-9.name: Cobra Lunge
stats: Lunge if Slightly Out of Range
description: When you attempt to use Serpent Strike against a target that is slightly out of range you will lunge forwards before attacking.

st31et-27.name: Shroud of Winter
description: You have additional dodge rating per cold resistance, for each stack of the {Slither} buff.

st31et-7.name: Poison Tipped
description: Serpent Strike hits have a higher chance to poison on hit and they deal more melee damage per stack of poison on the target, up to a limit.

st31et-22.name: Iron Scales
description: {Primal Serpents} have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional armour

st31et-16.name: Corrosive Venom
description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

st31et-5.name: Serpent Venom
description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to inflict {Serpent Venom}, an ailment that deals poison damage over time and prevents enemies from landing critical strikes. It lasts 3 seconds and cannot stack.

st31et-28.name: Swirling Carnage
description: Each active stack of {Maelstrom} grants Serpent Strike additional chance to inflict bleed on hit and more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

st31et-30.name: Shattered Immunity
stats: +1% Serpent Venom Damage Per Frostbite Stack
description: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the number of poison and frostbite stacks on them, up to a maximum benefit from each ailment.
reminderText: For example with 2 points invested, you can receive up to 200% more damage from poison by having 100 poison stacks on the enemy, and up to 200% more damage from frostbite by having 100 frostbite stacks on the enemy.

st31et-15.name: Hydra Strikes
description: Serpent Strike has increased attack speed.

st31et-10.name: Constrictor
description: You gain a stack of {Constrictor} every 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 4. When you use Serpent Strike all stacks are consumed causing the attack to deal more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: The stacks are not multiplicative with each other.

st31et-24.name: Guardian Spear
description: Instead of summoning a new serpent when the {Primal Serpent} node's effect triggers, you heal your current serpent to full health and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This damage buff can stack.
reminderText: This effect triggers when you kill an enemy and roll to summon.

st31et-14.name: Gouging Spear
description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

st31et-29.name: Steel Eater
description: Armour Shred inflicted by Serpent Strike has an increased effect based on your Dexterity.

st31et-23.name: Emerald Fangs
description: {Primal Serpents}'s hits have an additional chance to poison enemies and inflict {frailty}.

st31et-32.name: Dread Fang
description: Ailments applied by Serpent Strike and {Primal Serpents} have additional poison penetration.

st31et-13.name: Slither
description:
You gain {Slither} for 4 seconds when you use Serpent Strike and hit at least one enemy.

Each stack grants you more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers).

st31et-21.name: Vicious Strikes
stats: 10 Primal Serpent Health Granted On Melee Hit
description: {Primal Serpents} have increased melee attack speed and are granted health when they hit enemies with a melee attack.

st31et-17.name: Devour Prey
description: You regain health when Serpent Strikes kills or critically strikes an enemy.

st31et-3.name: Culling Point
description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to instantly kill enemies that are below a threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
reminderText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

st31et-4.name: Coldfang
description: Serpent Strike hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

st31et-12.name: Sapping Coils
description: You regain mana when you consume a stack of {Constrictor}.

st31et-26.name: Biting Winds
description: Frostbite inflicted by Serpent Strike lasts longer and has additional cold penetration

st31et-8.name: Venomous Union
stats: 2 Venom Novas on Lunge (12 Second Cooldown)
description:
When you lunge forwards with Serpent Strike, if you have a {Scorpion} it casts its companion ability, {Venom Nova}, twice, once centred on itself, and once centred on you.

This effect has a 12 second cooldown, but ignores Venom Nova's regular cooldown and does not put it on cooldown.

st31et-31.name: Fast Acting Toxins
stats: +2% Serpent Venom Damage per Melee Crit Chance
+100% Serpent Venom Speed with >50% Melee Crit Chance
description:
Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your melee critical strike chance.

If your melee crit chance is above 50% then Serpent Venom deals its damage twice as quickly. This does not increase the total damage it deals over its full duration, but rather halves its duration and doubles its damage per second.

st31et-2.name: Primal Serpent
stats: 2% Summon Chance on Rare or Boss Hit
description: When Serpent Strike kills an enemy or hits a rare or boss enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Primal Serpent}.

st31et-11.name: Mussurana
description: Each stack of {Constrictor} also grants Serpent Strike additional poison chance and increased poison duration when consumed

st31et-6.name: Spirit Viper
stats: 1 Mana Gain with at least 50 Vitality
description: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Vitality, and if you have 50 Vitality you regain mana when you inflict an enemy with Serpent Venom or refresh its duration.

st31et-20.name: Frostwyrm's Fury
description:
Serpent Strike now has a chance to freeze and its base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite chance.

er6no-6.name: Renewing Pollen
description:
The spores from {Seeds} now heal you and your allies. 

This effect is tripled for minions.

er6no-30.name: Flourish
description: Entangling Roots has increased mana efficiency.

er6no-5.name: Poisonous Seeds
description:
Entangling Roots now creates seeds in the area. When an enemy draws too close to a seed it bursts, releasing a burst of spores that slow and poison enemies.

If you have taken the {Winternid Thorns} node, the seed bursts inflict {Frostbite} and {Chill} instead of slow and poison.

er6no-7.name: Nectar of Rejuvenation
description: Seeds now burst when an ally draws close to them which grants you and your allies the {Haste} buff, granting you 30% increased movement speed.

er6no-29.name: Venomsting
description:
Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to have additional chance to poison on hit. This buff lasts 8 seconds and does not stack.

The effect is tripled for Scorpions and Serpents.

er6no-13.name: Bramblewood Wardens
description: Entangling Roots now also wraps around your Spriggans for twice the duration as enemies, granting them all buffs from {Frenzying Thorns} as well as additional projectiles with their {Thorn Volley}.

er6no-14.name: Reclamation
description: Entangling Roots leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.

er6no-2.name: Toxic Envelopment
description: Root Wave hits have a chance to poison enemies, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

er6no-15.name: Noxious Grasp
description: Entangling Roots deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: This also affects any damage over time ailments that Entangling Roots applies.

er6no-22.name: Winternid Thorns
description:
Entangling Roots' base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Physical Resistance Shred from all sources is converted to Cold Resistance Shred chance and effects related to Physical Resistance Shred now depend on Cold Resistance Shred instead.

er6no-10.name: Entrapped
description: Enemies hit by the Root Wave are rooted for an increased duration. This affects the immobilize duration, the total damage dealt, and any other effects attached to the root.

er6no-9.name: Rampant Growth
description: Seeds will now grow {Vines} when they burst.
reminderText: These vines scale with your {Spriggan Form} tree as if they had been summoned by the {Summon Vines} skill.

er6no-8.name: Earthy Puffball
description: Seeds now burst when you hit them with {Upheaval} and deal damage in a larger area when detonated this way.

er6no-18.name: Rooted System
description: Entangling Roots is now cast from the nearest totem to your cursor.

er6no-3.name: Venomous Briar
description: Entangling Roots' base physical damage over time is converted to poison and it now has the poison tag. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.
reminderText: This has no effect if you have taken the {Winternid Thorns} node.

er6no-27.name: Blooming Magic
description: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional damage with spells for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

er6no-21.name: Thick Growth
description: Root Wave's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have a higher chance to stun enemies.

er6no-16.name: Lethal Spines
description: Entangling Roots damage accelerates over time, dealing more damage each second (multiplicative with other modifiers).

er6no-25.name: Nourishment Surge
description:
Root Wave now heals other allies it hits, and has increased area of effect. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

This effect is tripled for minions.

er6no-12.name: Frenzying Thorns
stats: +10% Attack Speed To Totems And Vines
+10% Cast Speed To Totems And Vines
description: Entanging Roots now wraps around your totems and vines for twice the duration as enemies, granting them additional armor and increased attack and cast speed.

er6no-17.name: Overgrown Garden
description: You now cause Entangling Roots to expand in a circle around you rather than a cone in front, but it now has a cooldown.

er6no-20.name: Shredding Vines
description: Root Wave hits shred enemy physical resistance.

er6no-23.name: Iceshard Roots
description:
Root Wave has a chance to inflict {Frostbite}.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite for Root Wave and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

Root Wave gains additional freeze rate per character level.

er6no-4.name: Kobra Vines
description: Rooted enemies are also blinded.

er6no-26.name: Wild Weapons
description: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional physical damage with spells and attacks for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

er6no-19.name: Briarthorn's Wrath
description:
When you are stunned, you now cast Entangling Roots. 

This effect has a 20 seconds cooldown, which doesn't affect Entangling Root's cooldown.

er6no-28.name: Bush Stalkers
stats: +5% Wolves And Bear Base Crit Chance
description: Root Wave causes your Wolves and Bear it hits to have improved base critical strike chance and deal more damage with critical strikes for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

er6no-11.name: Inescapable Thicket
description: Root Wave cannot be dodged.

er6no-24.name: Destructive Growth
description: Root Wave lowers the physical resistance of affected enemies for the duration of its root. This effect stacks.
reminderText: Converting the base damage of Entangling Roots will also convert the resistance affected by this node.

eb5656-3.name: Embolden
stats: 25% Increased Spell Damage On Next Cast
description: Your next spell after casting Eterra's Blessing deals increased damage.

eb5656-10.name: Swift Recovery
description: When Eterra's Blessing targets a downed companion, it heals them for a portion of their maximum downed duration.

eb5656-23.name: Improved Blessing
description: Eterra's Blessing has increased healing effectiveness.

eb5656-14.name: Soul Bond
description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Spriggan} companion, you are both granted increased spell damage for 4 seconds.

eb5656-20.name: Rosebloom
description:
Whenever you directly cast Thorn Shield, you also cast Eterra's Blessing on the same target.

Consumes Eterra's Blessing's mana cost as rage.

eb5656-15.name: Overgrowth
stats: 25% Chance To Heal Allies Nearby Target
description: Eterra's Blessing has a chance to heal all allies nearby its target for 50 health.
reminderText: The area in which allies are healed is affect by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

eb5656-8.name: Ardent Touch
description: When cast on a minion, Eterra's Blessing also grants increased movement, attack, and cast speed for 4 seconds.

eb5656-4.name: Lifestream
description: After casting Eterra's Blessing, your spells leech a portion of the damage they deal as health for 4 seconds.

eb5656-28.name: Tranquil Spirit
description: When you are out of mana Eterra's Blessing is free, but Eterra's Blessing can no longer provide additional buffs.

eb5656-11.name: Eterra's Furor
description: When you directly cast Eterra's Blessing on a companion it taunts nearby enemies for 4 seconds. However Eterra's Blessing now has a long cooldown.

eb5656-5.name: Natural Affinity
description: When cast on a minion, Eterra's Blessing grants stun immunity for 4 seconds.

eb5656-6.name: Caustic Renewal
description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Scorpion} companion, you are both granted a chance to poison enemies with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.

eb5656-12.name: Binding Heal
description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on one of your companions, you also heal yourself for a portion of its base heal amount.

eb5656-27.name: Regrowth
description: When {Efflorescence's} heal over time expires, heal again for half of Eterra's Blessing's value.

eb5656-7.name: Symbiosis
description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Sabertooth} or {Raptor} companions, you are both granted a chance to cause enemies to bleed with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.

eb5656-32.name: Savage Boon
description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Wolf} or {Bear} companions, you are both granted increased physical damage for 4 seconds.

eb5656-29.name: Ancestral Renewal
stats: 34# Chance To Summon Healing Totem On High Health Heal
description: When you heal a target that is already at high health, you have a chance to summon a {Healing Totem} at its location which heals nearby allies.
reminderText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

eb5656-2.name: Safeguard
description: Eterra's Blessing grants elemental and poison resistance.

eb5656-30.name: Boon of the Shifter
description: Eterra's Blessing heals for more if you have transformed recently (last 4 seconds).

eb5656-18.name: Rebuke
description: Eterra's Blessing knocks back enemies a given distance from its target.
reminderText: Increased Area for Area Skills stats affect the area in which enemies are pushed back, but not how far they are pushed back.

eb5656-26.name: Efflorescence
description: Eterra's Blessing heals half of its value immediately, and half of its value over 4 seconds.

eb5656-21.name: Skyboon
description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your Storm Crow companions, they are granted {Haste} and Frenzy for 5 seconds.

eb5656-13.name: Triage
description: Eterra's Blessing automatically targets the lowest health ally in range, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.

eb5656-16.name: Conservation
description: Eterra's Blessing costs less mana.

eb5656-9.name: Encourage
description: When Eterra's Blessing heals one of your companions it has a chance to refresh its activated ability cooldown, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.

eb5656-24.name: Purge
description: Eterra's Blessing cleanses all ailments on its target.

sw43-2.name: Claws of the Bear
description: Swipe deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and slows enemies, but has a cooldown.

sw43-13.name: Way of the Hunt
description: Swipe deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of damage dealt as health.

sw43-15.name: Aspect of the Panther
description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of Aspect of the Panther. Each stack lasts 4 seconds and grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: Stacks are not multiplicative with each other, i.e. 2 stacks gives 10% more damage, not 10.25%.

sw43-11.name: Umjol's Guidance
description:
Swipe has a chance to shock on hit and a portion of Swipe's base damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

If you have 5 points in this node, Swipe loses its {Physical} tag.

sw43-18.name: Lupine Attunement
description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you call forth a {Spirit Wolf} from each of your summoned wolves.
reminderText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

sw43-20.name: Wrath of the Wild
description: Swipe deals more Lightning Damage per stack of Shock on the target and more Cold Damage per stack of Chill on the target.
reminderText: These effects are multiplicative with each other and with other modifiers.

sw43-6.name: Duality of Nature
description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you gain health if you are transformed, or mana if you are not transformed.
reminderText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

sw43-12.name: Storm Scour
description: Swipe has additional lightning penetration based on your Attunement

sw43-14.name: Claws of Stone
stats: 10% Chance To Summon Claw Totem On Kill
10% Chance to Summon Claw Totem On Rare or Boss hit
description: You have a chance to summon a {Claw Totem} when Swipe kills an enemy or hits a rare or boss enemy.

sw43-19.name: Feline Hunter
description: While you have {Aspect of the Panther} you have increased attack and cast speed. This does not scale with the number of stacks.

sw43-3.name: Twin Fangs
description: While you have {Aspect of the Panther} you have additional critical strike multiplier per Stack. This bonus is doubled if you are dual wielding.

sw43-4.name: Blood Beast
description: Swipe hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

sw43-5.name: Rending
description: Swipe has a chance to shred physical resistance on hit.

sw43-8.name: Sabertooth's Endurance
stats: Aspect of the Panther affects Sabertooth
description:
Each stack of {Aspect of the Panther} lasts longer and grants increased health regen.

Aspect of the Panther also applies to your {Sabertooth} if you have one.
reminderText: This effect does not apply to your Sabertooth if triggered by Claw Totem or other minion using Swipe.

sw43-17.name: Wild Calling
description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to call forth a {Spirit Wolf} from each of your summoned wolves.
reminderText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

sw43-9.name: Storm Claw
description:
Swipe deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Every 3 seconds, your next Swipe deals damage in a larger area and has its base damage converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

Swipe gains a {Lightning} tag.

sw43-16.name: Lion's Strength
stats: +1 Maximum Aspect of the Panther Stacks
description: Aspect of the Panther can have more stacks and each stack grants you additional melee damage.

sw43-22.name: Primal Resonance
stats: 100% Nearest Companion Health Restored on Hit
description: When you use Swipe and hit at least one enemy your nearest companion uses its companion ability and is restored to full health.
reminderText:
This does not require the companion's ability to be off cooldown and does not put it on cooldown or invoke its mana cost.

Downed companions are excluded.

This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

sw43-10.name: Lagon's Fury
stats: Storm Claw Cooldown Reset on Totem Summon
description: The cooldown for the effect of the {Storm Claw} node is reset if you summon a Totem.

sw43-24.name: Trapper
description: Swipe hits deal more damage against slowed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers)

sw43-21.name: Wengarian Reach
description: Swipe deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

sw43-7.name: Culling
description:
Swipe hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

sw43-23.name: Avatar of Stone
description: When you use Swipe and hit at least one enemy, all your totems gain +1 Melee Damage and +1 Spell Damage. This buff stacks and lasts until the totems expire.
reminderText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

sbf4m-4.name: Feverous Stings
description: Yours and your {Locusts'} hits have a chance to poison enemies.

sbf4m-8.name: Bountiful Hibernacula
description: When a {Hive} releases a {Locust} you regain health and {Rage}.

sbf4m-31.name: Army of the Tempest
stats: -1 Howling Cascade Stacks To Proc Tornado
description: Reduce the maximum stacks of {Howling Cascade} required to cast {Tornado}, and tornadoes cast via Howling Cascade deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sbf4m-11.name: Chitin Sleet Storm
description: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance of freezing enemies per point of Attunement.

sbf4m-16.name: Ironclad Beetle
description: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while in Swarmblade Form.

sbf4m-30.name: Windfury Strikes
stats: Gain Howling Cascade Stacks On Hit With Slash
description:
You gain a stack of {Howling Cascade} when you use Armblade Slash and hit at least one enemy. Reaching 6 stacks consumes them to cast {Tornado}.

This consumes Tornado's mana cost.

sbf4m-10.name: Frost Bites
description:
The base damage of Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm}, and Dive is converted to cold, and {Locusts'} base melee damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. These attack all also gain a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance while in Swarmblade Form.

Your {Locusts'} Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance.

sbf4m-32.name: Stormslash
description: When you use Armblade Slash and hit at least one enemy, you consume rage to gain a {Storm Stack}.
reminderText: Storm Stacks are normally granted by Gathering Storm and are expended every second to cause a Storm Bolt to strike a nearby enemy.

sbf4m-21.name: Swarm's Fury
description:
After using Swarm Strike, Human Form is now replaced with {Angered Swarm}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of your {Locust Swarm} and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

sbf4m-9.name: Release the Horde
description: Your Armblade Slash can now hit your own Hives which causes them to release {Locusts}.

sbf4m-14.name: Water Strider
description:
You cast {Maelstrom} a number of times when you Dive. 

This consumes a portion of Maelstrom's mana cost as {Rage}.

sbf4m-7.name: Swarmkeeper's Call
description:
After using Summon Hive, Human Form is now replaced with {Cleanse Hives}, which releases all {Locusts} from up to 2 Hives, replaces them with {Healing Totems} and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

sbf4m-15.name: Springer's Fury
description: You gain {Rage} when you dodge.

sbf4m-29.name: Endless Pressure
stats: +2 Health And Rage Gain On Kill
+2 Health And Rage Gain On Boss or Rare Hit
description: You regain health and {Rage} when you or your {Locusts} kill an enemy or when you hit a rare enemy or boss.

sbf4m-24.name: Earth Stinger
stats: +4 Swarm Melee Physical Damage Per Locust
description: You and your {Locusts} deal additional melee physical damage while in Swarmblade Form and your {Locust Swarm} deals additional melee physical damage per active {Locust} consumed when you use Swarm Strike.

sbf4m-13.name: Locust Agility
description: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance to dodge and additional armor while in Swarmblade Form.

sbf4m-35.name: Soaring Scourge
description: {Locust Swarm} now scales with your minion damage rather than your damage.

sbf4m-6.name: Hive Mind
stats: 1 Locusts per 3 seconds from Locust Swarm
description: Hives release {Locusts} more frequently and if you have an active {Locust Swarm} it also releases Locusts every second.
reminderText: A Locust Swarm does not lose damage or otherwise change as it releases locusts, but cannot release more Locusts than were originally gathered to create it.

sbf4m-3.name: Bloodlust Swarm
stats: 5% Locust Swarm Increased Damage Per Bleed
description:
When you create a {Locust Swarm} with Swarm Strike you consume all stacks of bleed from enemies hit by it, causing the {Swarm} to deal increased damage in a larger area per stack of bleed consumed.

The increased area scales up to a maximum.

sbf4m-27.name: Grasshopper's Frenzy
stats: +1 Rage Gain When You Or Locusts Crit
description: You regain {Rage} when you or your {Locusts} critically hit.

sbf4m-18.name: Vampiric Mandibles
description: Your {Locust Swarm} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you

sbf4m-2.name: Death by a Thousand Wings
description: Your Armblade Slash, Dive and {Locust} hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

sbf4m-17.name: Slashing Spiral
description: Your Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm} and your {Locusts'} melee attacks all deal damage in a larger area.

sbf4m-25.name: Needle-Like Sting
description: You and your {Locusts} have improved base critical strike chance while in Swarmblade Form.

sbf4m-20.name: Neverending Drove
description: {Locust Swarm} has more duration and Swarm Strike hits deal more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

sbf4m-12.name: Spiked Vespiary
description:
Your Hives now cast {Thorns} using your {Thorn Totem} skill tree, rather than releasing {Locusts}.

Your Hives are not totems, and are not affected by totem modifiers.
reminderText: If you have the {Release the Horde} node, hitting a Hive will release thorns.

sbf4m-26.name: Hornet Nest
description: You can only control half as many {Locusts}, but they have significantly more health, deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger.
reminderText: The maximum number of locusts is rounded up.

sbf4m-22.name: Inspiring Swarm
stats: Random Companion Ability After Swarm Strike
description: A random active companion uses its active ability after you directly use Swarm Strike.

sbf4m-5.name: Grand Colony
description: You can control additional {Locusts} and your Hives contain additional {Locusts}.

sbf4m-34.name: Wasp Flight
description: You have increased attack and cast speed while in Swarmblade form.

sbf4m-28.name: Viper's Call
stats: Serpent Strike Tree Affects Armblade Slashes
description:
Your {Serpent Strike} tree now applies to Armblade Slashes, and it does not require a spear.

This effect does not include the base additional poison chance or increased poison duration from Serpent Strike.

sbf4m-23.name: Plague of Locusts
stats: +4% Poison Chance Per Locust While Swarm Active
description: Your {Locust Swarm} deals more damage per {Locust} consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers) and while the Locust Swarm is active you have additional chance to poison on hit per {Locust} consumed.

sbf4m-36.name: Carnage
stats: +2 Rage On Hit With Swarm Strike And Dive
description: Swarm Strike and Dive deal more damage and you regain {Rage} on hit with both skills.

ga2st-8.name: Whirlwind Tactics
stats: 1 Expends Storm Stacks On Companion Use
description:
Whenever you use a companion ability you expend {Storm Stacks} over the next 0.3 seconds.

Storm Bolts triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ga2st-20.name: Island Cleaver
description: Gathering Storm's melee attack deals damage in a larger area and you have a chance to gain an additional {Storm Stack} if you hit at least 3 enemies with the same melee attack.

ga2st-15.name: Two Eyed Storm
stats: Additional Storm Bolt While Dual Wielding
description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} while dual wielding you now cast {Storm Bolts} at two enemies instead of one.

ga2st-14.name: Excited Bolts
description: {Storm Bolts} now consume a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10 current mana, up to a maximum.
reminderText: The amount of mana consumed is also restricted by the max damage bonus, so having more than 1,000 current mana won't consume more than 10 mana.

ga2st-13.name: Thunderous Strikes
description: Gathering Storm penetrates enemy lightning resistance.
reminderText: If Gathering Storm is converted to physical or cold then this grants physical or cold penetration.

ga2st-24.name: Earth Smasher
description:
Gathering Storm's and {Storm Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to armor shred chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm's {Lightning} tag for a {Physical} tag.

ga2st-2.name: Looming Clouds
description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} at an additional enemy.

ga2st-30.name: Rending Vortex
description: Gathering Storm has improved base critical strike chance per stack of {Maelstrom} on you from any source.

ga2st-4.name: In the Eye of the Storm
description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Maelstrom}.

ga2st-19.name: Energized by the Skies
description: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to consume mana to grant you additional {Storm Stacks}.
reminderText:
This has no effect if you have no current mana.

Mana consumption happens after the mana gain from the {Manafused Storm} node.

ga2st-6.name: A Storm Gathers
description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain a stack instead of losing one.

ga2st-16.name: Windfury Blows
description: Gathering Storm has increased attack speed.

ga2st-7.name: Lightning Gale
description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain {Haste}.

ga2st-11.name: Clouds on the Horizon
description: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from farther away.

ga2st-10.name: Lagonian Diplomacy
description: While wielding a staff the melee attack of Gathering Storm is replaced by a direct ranged cast of {Storm Bolt}, but Gathering Storm costs additional mana.
reminderText: Gathering Storm cast this way is affected by effects which apply to Gathering Storm and to Storm Bolt, but it is no longer a melee attack.

ga2st-23.name: Tempest Weapon
description:
Gathering Storm deals additional spell damage per 3 melee damage on your equipped axe or mace.

The added spell damage granted by this effect is significantly reduced when applied to a Storm Totem through its {Unmatched Storms}.

ga2st-12.name: Friends of the Tempest
description: If you have from 1 to 15 {Storm Stacks}, your minions' lightning skill hits have a chance to grant you a {Storm Stack}.
reminderText: If Gathering Storm is converted to physical or cold then this requires a physical or cold hit instead.

ga2st-27.name: Of Ice and Snow
description: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to chill enemies and a higher chance to freeze enemies.

ga2st-18.name: The Typhoon
stats: 15% Increased Stun Chance Per Storm Stack
+15% Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Storm Stack
description: You have increased global stun chance and additional freeze rate multiplier per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.

ga2st-17.name: Manafused Storm
stats: 1 Mana Gain Per Storm Stack On Use
description: Whenever you directly use Gathering Storm you gain mana per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.

ga2st-25.name: Seismic Crash
description: Gathering Storm deals additional melee damage per Strength while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

ga2st-28.name: Winter Comes
description: Gathering Storm has a higher chance to freeze enemies per 2 Attunement and it also has additional cold penetration for frostbite per 2 Attunement.

ga2st-21.name: Wings of Lightning
description:
Whenever you use Gathering Storm and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Wings of Lightning}.

Each time one of your {Storm Crows} attack, they consume a stack of Wings of Lightning, causing their basic attack to chain 2 additional times.

ga2st-26.name: Frostbringer
description:
Gathering Storm's and {Storm Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

ga2st-3.name: Concentrated Storm
description: Gathering Storm deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you expend {Storm Stacks} more frequently, but {Storm Bolts} target enemies within a smaller area.

ga2st-22.name: Jolting Strikes
description:
{Storm Bolts'} hits have chance to shock enemies.

Gathering Storm deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.
reminderText: If Gathering Storm is converted to cold or physical respectively this depends on frostbite or armor shred.

ga2st-9.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
description: Whenever you hit a boss or rare enemy with a {Storm Bolt} you have a chance to cast it again at the same enemy after 0.25 seconds.

sp38-14.name: Aura of Retribution
description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional base critical chance and critical strike avoidance.
reminderText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38-27.name: Garden of Nourishment
description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} now heals allies it hits.

sp38-4.name: Deadly Thicket
description: Your Spriggan's summoned {Vines} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38-21.name: Protective Roots
description: Your Spriggan now casts {Ensnaring Roots} towards you whenever there are enemies around you, rather than it casting towards enemies near itself.

sp38-18.name: Barbed Roots
description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38-17.name: Creeping Roots
description: Your Spriggan can now cast {Ensnaring Roots}, a wave of roots deals physical damage and roots enemies it hits for 1.5 seconds. Rooted enemies take physical damage over time until they are freed.

sp38-10.name: Brutal Mire
stats: +40% Thorn Hit Damage To Immobilized Enemies
+40% Thorn Hit Damage To Stunned Enemies
+40% Thorn Hit Damage To Frozen Enemies
description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} hits deal more damage to immobilized, stunned or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38-25.name: Frostleaf
description: Your Spriggan has a higher chance to freeze enemies. Your Spriggans Aura grants its allies a higher chance to freeze enemies.

sp38-28.name: Invading Underbrush
description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} can no longer be dodged.

sp38-7.name: Floral Ascendance
description: Your Spriggan deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38-23.name: Lasting Roots
description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} lasts longer.

sp38-6.name: Attuned Vines
description: Your Spriggan's summoned {Vines} have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional poison resistance.

sp38-3.name: Vine Mastery
description: Your Spriggan's Summon Vine ability has a shorter cooldown.

sp38-20.name: Branches of Winter
description:
Thorn Volley's and Ensnaring Roots' base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. They also have a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources, for both skills, is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

sp38-12.name: Aura of Life
description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} and {Rejuvenating Wind} restore more health.
reminderText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38-30.name: Aura of Hordes
stats: +3% Attack and Cast Speed per Wolf
description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} grants additional effects based on the amount of active companions you have.
For each {Wolf}, it grants increased attack and cast speed.
For each {Storm Crow}, it grants increased mana regeneration.
For each {Raptor}, it grants additional critical strike multiplier.
reminderText:
Squirrels grant half as much increased attack and cast speed as Wolves.
If multiple players are providing Spriggans with these effects, only the strongest of each effect will apply.

Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38-31.name: Aura of Voracity
stats: +3% Maximum Health Gained As Endurance Threshold with Bear
description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} grants additional effects based on your active companions.
With a {Bear}, it grants a percentage of max health gained as endurance threshold.
With a {Sabertooth}, it grants increased dodge rating.
With a {Scorpion}, it grants increased area of effect.
reminderText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38-11.name: Vile Bramble
stats: +20% Thorn Hit Damage To Poisoned Enemies
description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} hits deal more damage to poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38-5.name: Forest Raiser
description: Your Spriggan's {Summon Vine} ability now summons three vines at a time, but has a significantly longer cooldown (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38-2.name: Briar Summoner
description:
Your Spriggan can now use {Summon Vine}, melee minions that poison enemies they hit, up to a maximum of 6 Vines.

These Vines are not affected by your Vine limit or nodes on the {Spriggan Form} tree.

sp38-22.name: Nature’s Reach
description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} has a shorter cooldown.

sp38-13.name: Aura of Kinship
description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional spell damage.
reminderText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38-15.name: Arboreal Vitality
description: Your Spriggan has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38-29.name: Thorny Stalks
description: For each Spriggan you control, you and your Spriggans reflect flat damage to attackers per point of Vitality.

sp38-24.name: Aura of Loyalty
description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} restores significantly more health to minions.
reminderText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38-26.name: Aura of Evasion
description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional dodge rating per point of your Attunement.

This effect is doubled on minions.
reminderText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38-8.name: Thorn Barrage
description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} has a chance to fire 2 extra Thorns.

sp38-16.name: Warding Bark
description: Your Spriggan has additional armor and physical resistance.

sp38-9.name: Barbed Assault
description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} always fires 1 extra Thorn and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

th39-13.name: Torrent of Thorns
description: Thorn Totems have a chance to release twice as many thorns with each burst.

th39-23.name: Eternal Forest
description: Thorn Totems last longer and have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers)

th39-11.name: Winterwood
description: Thorn Totem deals additional spell cold damage, including its own thorns.

th39-21.name: Oaken Protection
description: Thorn Totems have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional physical resistance.

th39-7.name: Rotten Core
description:
When Thorn Totems die or are unsummoned they release a {Poison Burst}, which deals a small amount of physical spell damage on hit and inflicts poison.

Thorn Totem gains a {Poison} tag, but this does not affect the damage type of Thorn Totems' other abilities.
reminderText: If you have the {Pillars of Heorot} node, 100% of Poison Burst's hit damage is converted to cold.

th39-14.name: Titan's Bane
stats: +10% Thorn Hit Damage vs Rares and Bosses
description: Thorn Totems fire only one thorn with each burst, but they have massively increased cast speed, are more accurate with their thorns, and their thorns' hits deal more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: {Torrent of Thorns} can still double the number of thorns in each burst to 2.

th39-25.name: Nightshade Briar
description: Thorn Totem's thorn hits deal more damage per stack of poison on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to a maximum.
reminderText:
At 20 or more stacks this grants 80% more hit damage.

If you have taken the {Pillars of Heorot} node, this node's effect depends on the number of Frostbite stacks on the target instead of the number of poison stacks.

th39-4.name: Memories of Eterra
description: You regain mana when a Thorn Totem dies or is unsummoned.
reminderText: You can only regain mana from Thorn Totems that were summoned directly.

th39-16.name: Ancient Power
description: Thorn Totem deals more damage, but has less cast speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

th39-20.name: Frenetic Attunement
description: You summon Thorn Totem faster and all Thorn Totems have increased cast speed.

th39-8.name: Lasting Affliction
description: Poison and Frostbite inflicted by Thorn Totem last longer.

th39-3.name: Grove Mind
stats: Totems Summoned In Ring At Location
+15 Mana Cost Per Additional Totem Summoned
description: You summon your maximum number of Thorn Totems at once in a ring around the target location, but your maximum number of Thorn Totems is reduced and Summon Thorn Totem costs additional mana per additional totem summoned.
reminderText: Thorn totems that would be created in innaccessible locations are not created at all, but still increase the mana cost.

th39-10.name: Frost Attunement
stats: +5% Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Point Of Attunement
description: Thorn Totem has a higher chance to freeze enemies, and a greater chance to freeze enemies for each point of Attunement you have.
reminderText: This scales with your attunement, not the attunement of your totems.

th39-24.name: Lethal Thicket
description: Thorn Totems have an increased critical strike chance and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

th39-19.name: Winged Thorns
description: Thorn Totem's thorns travel faster and farther.

th39-17.name: Impale
description: Thorn Totem's thorns have a chance to deal double damage on hit.

th39-5.name: Totemic Wisdom
description: Summon Thorn Totem costs less mana.

th39-9.name: Pillars of Heorot
description:
Thorn Totem's thorns gain a chance to freeze and 100% of their base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently its damage now scales with your totems' increases to cold damage instead of physical damage.

All poison chance is converted to frostbite chance for Thorn Totems.

Thorn Totems have additional cold resistance.
reminderText: Freeze rate grants a chance to freeze based on the enemy's health.

th39-18.name: Shred Armor
description: Thorn Totem hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

th39-12.name: On Astral Winds
description: Thorn Totems deal more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but their projectiles travel more slowly.

th39-6.name: Venom Tipped Thorns
description: Thorn Totem hits have a chance to poison enemies.

th39-2.name: Forested Expanse
description: You can have additional Thorn Totems active, but Summon Thorn Totem costs more mana.

th39-15.name: Spriggans' Wrath
description: Thorn Totem's thorns can pierce enemies up to a maximum

th39-22.name: Guided Thorns
description: Thorn Totem's thorns now seek nearby targets, but Thorn Totem has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: This doesn't change the fact that multiple thorns cannot hit the same target

wb8fo-12.name: Intimidating Cry
description:
After using Rampage, you now {Roar}.

This consumes Warcry's mana cost as Rage and puts it on cooldown.
reminderText: This uses {Warcry's} skill tree.

wb8fo-21.name: Territorial
description: Maul and Roar affects a larger area.

wb8fo-27.name: Pummel and Bash
stats: +2 Rage Gained With Maul To Stunned
description: Maul deals more melee damage to stunned enemies and you regain {Rage} when you hit a stunned enemy with Maul.

wb8fo-15.name: Insatiable
stats: +2% Base Crit Chance For Maul And Rampage
description: Maul and Rampage have improve base critical strike chance and you have global increased critical strike chance while in Werebear Form.

wb8fo-2.name: Ursine Heart
description: You have additional endurance and endurance threshold while in Werebear Form.

wb8fo-4.name: Relentless Thunder
description: For 6 seconds after you enter Werebear Form, you deal more Lightning Damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 100% of Swipe's Base Damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with lightning damage instead of physical damage.

wb8fo-32.name: Tremor Slam
description:
After using Maul, you now use {Upheaval} towards your target.

This consumes Upheaval's mana cost.
reminderText: If you have the {Skull Crusher} node that makes {Fury Leap}'s tree apply to Maul and you have the {Violent Upheaval} node that tree causes it to cast {Upheaval} then instead of Upheaval being cast twice, it is cast once but that cast deals 30% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wb8fo-33.name: Barrage of the Swarm
description:
After directly using Roar, Human Form is now replaced with {Swarm Call}, which summons a {Locust} for each nearby stunned enemy up to 6 and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

wb8fo-19.name: Bloodthirst
description:
Your hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed while in Werebear Form.

This chance is doubled for Maul.

wb8fo-6.name: Ursine Storm
stats: +8% Chance To Cast Maelstrom On Use
description:
You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you use Swipe or Maul and hit at least one enemy.

This consumes Maelstrom's mana cost as Rage.

wb8fo-7.name: Rip and Tear
description: Maul and Rampage deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wb8fo-10.name: Eterra's Renewal
description: When you leave Werebear Form you cleanse all negative ailments and gain {Haste} for 3 seconds.

wb8fo-29.name: Ruthless
description: Your {Rage} decays slower while in Werebear Form.

wb8fo-31.name: Skull Crusher
stats: Consumes Fury Leap's Mana Cost As Rage
description:
Your {Fury Leap} tree now applies to Maul. 

This consumes Fury Leap's mana cost as Rage.
reminderText: You still use Maul's travel distance.

wb8fo-3.name: Frenzied Strikes
description: You regain additional {Rage} if you hit at least one enemy with {Swipe}.

wb8fo-22.name: Fury of the Maul
description: Maul has a shorter cooldown.

wb8fo-25.name: Enrage
stats: +2 Rage Gain On Roar Per Enemy
+15 Health Gain On Roar Per Enemy
description: You regain {Rage} and health with Roar per enemy hit, up to a maximum number of enemies.

wb8fo-5.name: Wisened Claws
description: You gain additional spell damage per point of Strength while in Werebear Form.

wb8fo-8.name: Dauntless
description: Rampage has increased movement speed, a higher chance to stun enemies and stuns inflicted by Rampage last longer.

wb8fo-11.name: Voice of the Thicket
description:
After using Rampage, Human Form is now replaced with {Arboreal Protection}, which casts {Thorn Shield} on you and up to 5 nearby allies and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

wb8fo-14.name: Unending Storm
description:
Rampage has no cooldown.

While using Rampage you move more slowly, but deal more lightning damage. Both of these effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

This removes Rampage's {Traversal} tag.

wb8fo-18.name: Invigoration
stats: +3 Health Gained On Kill Or Hit
+3 Rage Gained On Kill Or Hit
description: You regain health and {Rage} on kill or when you hit a rare or boss enemy.

wb8fo-24.name: Wild Command
description: When you use Maul and hit at least one enemy, your minions deal increased damage for 8 seconds. This effect can stack.

wb8fo-9.name: Apex Predator
description: Rampage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have global increased damage while Rampaging.

wb8fo-13.name: Army Sunderer
description: Rampage and Maul hits shred enemy armor.
reminderText: Armour Shred reduces armour by 100, lasts 4 seconds, and can stack.

wb8fo-26.name: Bringer of Storms
stats: Armor Shred And Bleed -> Shock Chance
description:
Maul and Rampage's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Armor Shred and bleed chance from all sources is converted to shock and effects related to armor shred or bleed now depend on shock instead for Maul and Rampage.

wb8fo-17.name: Crackling Assault
stats: 1 Lightning Strikes Per Second While Rampaging
description: You cast {Storm Bolts} from the sky a number of times each second while Rampaging.

wb8fo-34.name: Woodland Bear
description:
After using Maul, you now cast {Entangling Roots}.

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost as Rage.

sf5rd-7.name: Barbed Thicket
stats: +25% Chance To Cast Thorn Shield On Nearest Vine
description: You now have a chance to also cast Thorn Shield on the nearest {Vine} when you cast Thorn Shield. Other allies with Thorn Shield deal global increased physical damage and have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

sf5rd-17.name: Roar of the Woodland
description:
After directly casting Thorn Shield, Human Form is now replaced with {Bark Skin}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of every Thorn Shield on you and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

sf5rd-24.name: Ire of Trees
description: Healing Totems are converted to Fury Totems and now restore {Rage} instead of healing, but can only affect you.
reminderText: This effect is affected by increased healing effectiveness.

sf5rd-35.name: Huntersbane
stats: Melee Attack -> Ranged Thorns For Vines
description: Your {Vines} now cast thorns from range, instead of using a melee attack. This is affected by nodes on this tree that affects Spirit Thorns, but they only fire 1 projectile and {Great Vine} fires 3 projectiles.

sf5rd-14.name: Introspection
stats: Thorn Shield Can Only Target You
description: Thorn Shield can now only target you and can no longer attach to other allies.
reminderText: This doesn't affect the Thorn Shield cast on other allies from the {Voice of the Thicket} node in the {Werebear} skill tree.

sf5rd-9.name: Stinging Bramble
description: {Thorn Burst} and Spirit Thorn hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

sf5rd-30.name: Cycle of Life
stats: +20% Vale Spirit Chance On Healing Totem Death
description: Your Healing Totems have a chance to summon a {Vale Spirit} when they die.

sf5rd-15.name: Bulb Growth
description: Thorn Shield has a chance to recast itself on the same target when it expires.

sf5rd-11.name: Ironbark
description: You have additional armor and increased armor while in Spriggan Form.

sf5rd-27.name: Ancestral Call
description: You gain {Rage} and ward when you directly cast Spirit Thorns and hit at least 1 enemy.

sf5rd-23.name: Guardian of Nature
description: Healing Totems have increased healing effectiveness.

sf5rd-20.name: Totem Warden
description: Your {Healing Totems} have more health and duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have increased summoning speed while in Spriggan Form.

sf5rd-3.name: Creeping Underbrush
stats: +6% Summon Vine Chance On Vine Death
description: You now have a chance to summon a new Vine next to a nearby enemy when a {Vine} dies. Vines have increased attack and cast speed.

sf5rd-26.name: Rose Meadow
description: Spirit Thorns and Thorn Shield deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sf5rd-18.name: Leaf Barrier
description: You gain ward equal to your armor when you enter Spriggan Form.

sf5rd-13.name: Eterra's Bulwark
description: Thorn Shield grants additional armor and increased armor.

sf5rd-32.name: Spirit Vortex
description: You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} on you when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.

sf5rd-16.name: Briar Shell
description: Thorn Shield reflects additional flat damage to attackers.

sf5rd-29.name: Spiritwhisperer
notScalingStats: 1 Vale Spirit Every 5 Spirit Thorn Casts
description: You now summon a {Vale Spirit} every 5 direct casts with Spirit Thorns, up to a maximum.

sf5rd-34.name: Ice Branch
description:
Spirit Thorns, Summon Vines and Thorn Shield's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. They also have a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources, for all three skills, is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

sf5rd-5.name: Garden of Rage
notScalingStats: 40% Chance to Gain Rage on Vine Melee Hit
20% Chance to Gain Rage on Vine Spell Hit
description:
Your {Vines} have a chance to grant you {Rage} on hit. Melee hits have a higher chance to grant Rage than spell hits.

If you have the {Great Vine} node the rage gained is 200% higher.

sf5rd-31.name: Valetide
stats: Cast Entangling Roots With Spirit Thorns
description:
When you directly cast Spirit Thorns while at maximum Vale Spirits, you consume them to cast {Entangling Roots} at the target area and you regain {Rage}, which deals more damage when cast this way (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost.

sf5rd-19.name: Friend of the Forest
description:
You summon an additional {Spriggan} when you enter Spriggan Form which doesn't count towards your Spriggan limit, but does count towards your companion limit.

You will not summon an additional Spriggan if you are already at your maximum companion limit.
reminderText: Spriggan summoned this way disappears when you exit Spriggan Form.

sf5rd-8.name: Spikeburst
description: {Thorn Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

sf5rd-12.name: Deep Roots
description: Thorn Shield lasts longer.

sf5rd-21.name: Spiked Totems
stats: Thorn Totem Tree Benefits Healing Totems
description: Healing Totems directly cast from this tree now also shoot thorns. {Thorn Totem's} skill tree, mana cost, cooldown and totem limit also apply to Healing Totems.

sf5rd-28.name: Branch Storm
stats: +8% Spirit Thorns Physical And Cold Penetration
description: Spirit Thorns has a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit) and they penetrate enemy physical and cold resistance.

sf5rd-2.name: Overgrowth
description: {Vines} deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

sf5rd-33.name: Nightshade
description: Your hits have a chance to poison enemies while in Spriggan Form and your Vines have a chance to poison enemies.

sf5rd-22.name: Unbound Garden
description: You now always summon 3 Healing Totems and you can have additional maximum Healing Totems.

sf5rd-4.name: Blades of the Forest
description:
After using Summon Vine, Human Form is now replaced with {Infestation}, which converts your 2 nearest {Vines} into {Hives} and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

sf5rd-25.name: Wrath of the Glade
description: You now have a chance to cast Spirit Thorns from each of your Healing Totems when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.

sf5rd-6.name: Great Vine
description:
You can now only summon 1 {Vine} at a time up to a maximum of 6, but they have significantly more health, size, threat generation and their melee attacks deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

Indirect casts only create a vine on every third cast.

sf5rd-10.name: Glacial Grove
stats: +15% Chance To Cast Maelstrom On Thorn Shield
description: You now also have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you directly cast Thorn Shield.

sc36pi-9.name: Sweet Release
description: Activating your Scorpion's ability summons additional {Baby Scorpions.}
reminderText: This cannot exceed your maximum number of Baby Scorpions.

sc36pi-11.name: Scurry
description: {Baby Scorpions} have increased attack and movement speed.

sc36pi-8.name: Temper Tantrum
description: {Baby Scorpions} deal more damage (damage is multiplicative with other modifiers) and their attacks have a chance to poison enemies.

sc36pi-24.name: Pus Sacks
stats: 10% Chance To Create Poison Pool When Hit
description: Your Scorpion has a chance when it is hit to create a {Poison Pool}. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.
reminderText: Poison Pool applies a stack of poison to enemies standing in it each second.

sc36pi-17.name: Shock and Claw
description: Your Scorpion has a chance to {Shock} on hit and deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of shock on the target.

sc36pi-19.name: Storm Conduit
description:
Your {Storm Bolts} will strike your scorpion to grant it a stack of {Charged}, up to 20.

Your scorpion's {Shock Nova} consumes all stacks of Charged to deal more damage per stack.
reminderText: Storm Bolts will only target your scorpion if it is within 20 meters and has less than 20 stacks of {Charged}.

sc36pi-10.name: Small Target
description: {Baby Scorpions} have more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sc36pi-26.name: Winternid Jaws
description: Your scorpion has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on hit and its Bleed Chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite Chance.

sc36pi-4.name: Pinches and Pokes
description: Your Scorpion's melee attacks have increased area of effect, and your Scorpion has increased attack speed.

sc36pi-6.name: Ironclad
description: Your Scorpion deals additional melee damage, and its Poison Chance from all sources is converted to Armour Shred Chance.

sc36pi-5.name: Blood Poisoning
description: Your Scorpion has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and it deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers)

sc36pi-20.name: Noxious Carapace
description: Your Scorpion deals more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sc36pi-15.name: Frozen Winds
stats: +25% Chance to Gain Maelstrom When You Do
description: Your scorpion has a chance to cast {Maelstrom} whenever you do. Maelstroms cast by your scorpion in this way use your Scorpion's stats, but your Maelstrom tree.
reminderText: Your scorpion will only cast {Maelstrom} on itself, not others.

sc36pi-3.name: Envenomed Prey
description: Your Scorpion deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Poison on the target (up to 30).
reminderText: This effect can be converted to shock or frostbite. If converted to shock, the damage per stack is tripled.

sc36pi-14.name: Ice Sting
description: Your Scorpion deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

sc36pi-28.name: Rest for the WIcked
description: Your scorpion has additional critical strike chance, and whenever it kills an enemy it restores a percentage of its maximum health.

sc36pi-12.name: Chromatic Carapace
description: Your Scorpion has additional elemental resistance, and its abilities have increased area of effect.

sc36pi-7.name: Maternal Instinct
description: Your Scorpion spawns a number of {Baby Scorpions} every 5 seconds. Baby Scorpions have an unlimited duration but can be killed.
reminderText:
Baby Scorpions count as minions of your Scorpion rather than your minions, but still benefit from stats that affect your minions, such as Increased Minion Damage.

Whenever your Scorpion summons baby scorpions it summons the maximum amount it can control.

sc36pi-2.name: Venomous Maw
description: Your scorpion's attacks grant health on hit, and have a higher chance to poison on hit.

sc36pi-18.name: Reverberating Strike
stats: 30% Large Avalanche Boulder on Melee Hit Chance
description:
Your scorpion has a chance on melee hit to cause a large {Avalanche} boulder to land on the target. The Avalanche boulder uses your scorpion's stats, but your Avalanche tree.

This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

sc36pi-16.name: Thunder Stinger
description:
Your Scorpion's activated ability is now {Shock Nova}, a spell that deals lightning damage and applies 3 stacks of {Shock} on hit.

The base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage. These melee attacks now have a {Lightning} tag instead of a {Physical} tag.

All sources of poison chance are converted to shock chance for your scorpion, and effects related to poison in this tree instead depend on shock.
reminderText:
This node has no effect if {Cold-Blooded} is allocated.

{Shock Nova} deals lightning damage in an area around the scorpion, with 400% effectiveness of added damage.

sc36pi-23.name: Deeper Puddle
description: {Venom Nova} leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for 4 seconds, which applies a stack of poison each second to enemies standing in the pool.

sc36pi-25.name: Brood Invigoration
description: {Poison Pools} grant you and your minions increased attack speed and cast speed and a chance to poison enemies.

sc36pi-22.name: Miasma
description: Your scorpion's {Venom Nova} deals damage in a larger area, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: Increased poison effect multiplies poison's damage and its reduction to poison resistance.

sc36pi-1.name: Steel Carapace
description: Your scorpion has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers), additional physical and poison resistance, and increased size.

sc36pi-13.name: Cold-Blooded
description:
Your scorpion takes less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

The base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not with increases to minion physical damage. These melee attacks now have a {Cold} tag instead of a {Physical} tag.

Your scorpion's melee attacks also gain a chance to freeze, with a freeze rate equal to twice their base damage.

ts85i-11.name: Attuned Slam
description: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost, but it also costs additional mana.

ts85i-6.name: Nature's Storm
description: If Tempest Strike's melee attack does not hit an enemy you consume a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} to cast a {Tempest} of the respective type.

ts85i-4.name: Thunderous Storm
description: You have a chance to also cast {Thunder Tempest} when you attack with cold or physical Tempest Strike.

ts85i-7.name: Scheme of the Architect
description: {Gladiator of Lagon} has double the effect on your totems and {Storm Crows} if you have at least 50 Intelligence.

ts85i-24.name: Warm Shelter
description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Frigid Tempest}, but it does not remove the cold strike from the combo.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

ts85i-30.name: Blizzard's Wrath
description: You have a chance to also cast {Frigid Tempest} when you attack with lightning or physical Tempest Strike.

ts85i-12.name: Looming Gale
description: You now create a {Tempest Totem} that casts a {Tempest} of the corresponding strike that created the totem. You are limited to 1 of each type of totem.
reminderText:
Disabling a type of {Tempest} causes the respective totem to cast cold projectiles instead.

Attack speed modifiers from this tree affect the summoning speed, but not the totem's cast speed.

Effects that occur "when you cast a Tempest" also occur when a Tempest Totem casts a Tempest.

ts85i-21.name: Gladiator of Lagon
description:
The melee hits grant you a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} for 8 seconds which grants you and your minions additional spell damage.

This effect can trigger a maximum of 3 times per second.

ts85i-8.name: Stormriding Companions
description: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy physical resistance per active physical minion, penetrates cold resistance per cold minion and penetrates lightning resistance per lightning minion.
reminderText: For example Wolves are a physical minion by default but can be specialized into being either a cold or lightning minion.

ts85i-35.name: Cloudburst Conduit
description: Whenever you cast {Thunder Tempest} you also cast it around your nearest {Storm Totem}.

ts85i-2.name: Lagonian Shamanism
description: You now have a chance to gain a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} when you cast a {Tempest}.
reminderText: This effect can still only trigger a maximum of 3 times per second.

ts85i-10.name: Druid's Call
description:
While transformed and you use any melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast each {Tempest} of a matching damage type.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tempest Strike's mana cost.
reminderText: For example if you use {Swipe} while transformed as a {Werebear}, you have a chance to cast a {Wind Tempest} on hit.

ts85i-3.name: Tempestuous Legend
description:
{Frigid Tempest} has a higher chance to freeze enemies.
{Thunder Tempest} has a chance to shock enemies.
{Wind Tempest} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ts85i-29.name: Devastating Whirlwind
description: {Tornados} cast from {Wind Tempest} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

ts85i-27.name: Wind Booster
description:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you and your other allies it touches gain {Haste} for a short duration.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have Haste.

ts85i-15.name: Windfury Force
description: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

ts85i-23.name: Resurgence of the Land
stats: 5 Mana Gain On Hit With No Tempest
description: You recover mana if whenever you use Tempest Strike and it hits an enemy and it doesn't cast a {Tempest}.

ts85i-26.name: Soaring Blows
stats: +1% Physical Pen Per 5% Uncapped Physical Res
+1% Cold Pen Per 5% Uncapped Cold Res
+1% Lightning Pen Per 5% Uncapped Lightning Res
description: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy resistances per your uncapped resistances corresponding to a specific type.

ts85i-20.name: Grounded Refuge
description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Thunder Tempest}, but it does not remove the lightning strike from the combo.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

ts85i-34.name: Fulminating Strikes
description:
{Thunder Tempest} shocks enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

ts85i-17.name: Firm Grip
description:
