Tempest Strike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

These effects are doubled while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

ts85i-33.name: Wrath of the Mountain
stats: Frigid Tempest Each Second During Avalanche
description: While channeling {Avalanche} you now also cast {Frigid Tempest} every second.

ts85i-5.name: Grand Cyclone
description: You have a chance to also cast {Wind Tempest} when you attack with lightning or cold Tempest Strike.

ts85i-25.name: Ancestral Swiftness
description: Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

ts85i-16.name: Heorot's Arsenal
stats: +5 Melee Damage With Axe Or Mace
description: Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per equipped axe or mace and additional spell damage while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

ts85i-28.name: Ceaseless Typhoon
description:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you have a chance to also cast {Tornado}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tornado's mana cost.
reminderText: This Tornado is always cast by you, even if the effect was triggered by a Tempest Totem.

ts85i-32.name: Coldest Night
description:
{Frigid Tempest} chills on enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

ts85i-19.name: Crashing Waves
description:
Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per 2 Attunement.

All the melee strikes have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

ts85i-18.name: Calm Seas
description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Wind Tempest}, but it does not remove the physical strike from the combo.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

ts85i-14.name: Sky Opener
description:
You now expend {Storm Stacks} when you use Tempest Strike and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack.

{Storm Bolts} cast this way deal more damage.

ts85i-9.name: Bulwark of Nature
description: Whenever you cast a {Tempest} you also regain a portion of your Endurance Threshold as health.

ts85i-13.name: Rousing Symbols
description: Your {Tempest Totems} gain a random amount of more cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) when summoned.

fl13-5.name: Storm Bringer
description: {Storm Bolts} occur with increased frequency.

fl13-22.name: Violent Upheaval
description: When you land with Fury Leap you cast Upheaval. This consumes Upheaval's mana cost and requires positive mana.

fl13-11.name: Gravity
description: Fury Leap pulls enemies when you land.

fl13-17.name: Aspect of the Mantis
stats: Reset Fury Leap Cooldown On Short Leap Kill
description:
Fury Leap's cooldown is reset when you kill an enemy with a short leap.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.
reminderText: A short leap is less than 10 meters.

fl13-25.name: Wind Hammer
description: Fury Leap deals more damage based on how far you leap.

fl13-12.name: Rise
stats: 25% Chance To Cast Summon Vines At Departure
description: Fury Leap has a chance to cast {Summon Vines} where you leap from.
reminderText:
{Summon Vines} is an active skill in Spriggan Form and can be scaled via the Spriggan Form tree.

The vines are stationary melee minions whose attacks poison on hit.

The vines scale with your bonuses to minions, but not with other nodes on this tree.

fl13-18.name: Unshackled
description: While you are below half health, Fury Leap always critically strikes.

fl13-27.name: Battle Bloom
description: When you land you cleanse all ailments on you and your minions.

fl13-14.name: Crater
description: Fury Leap deals damage in a larger area and costs less mana.

fl13-24.name: Heorot's Protection
description: You are immune to damage while leaping.

fl13-4.name: Lagon's Wrath
description: Fury Leap creates {Storm Bolts} while you are leaping.
reminderText: {Storm Bolt} is affected by your Gathering Storm tree.

fl13-3.name: Regain Stamina
stats: 5% Chance To Reset Fury Leap Cooldown On Kill
description:
You have a chance to reset Fury Leap's cooldown whenever you kill an enemy with any other skill.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.

fl13-13.name: Poisonous Thicket
stats: 25% Chance To Cast Summon Vines At Arrival
description: Fury Leap has a chance to cast {Summon Vines} where you land.
reminderText:
{Summon Vines} is an active skill in Spriggan Form and can be scaled via the Spriggan Form tree.

The vines are stationary melee minions whose attacks poison on hit.

The vines scale with your bonuses to minions, but not with other nodes on this tree.

fl13-10.name: Crushing Impact
description: Fury Leap has an increased chance to stun enemies and stuns it inflicts last longer.

fl13-6.name: Rejuvenating Storms
stats: +1 Spell Damage Per 2 Attunement While Leaping
30% Chance For Storm Bolt To Reset Fury Leap's Cooldown
description:
You have additional spell damage per 2 Attunement while leaping, and kills with {Storm Bolt} have a chance to reset Fury Leap's cooldown.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.

fl13-26.name: Wings of Endurance
description: When you land, you and your minions are healed.
reminderText: This is affected by your Increased Healing Effectiveness stat.

fl13-20.name: Panther Strike
description: Fury Leap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.

fl13-9.name: Pack Leader
description: Your Wolf, Sabertooth, and Raptor companions leap with you.

fl13-15.name: Ambush Predator
stats: +30% Hit Damage Against Enemies At Full Health
description: Fury Leap hits deal more damage against enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fl13-7.name: Warrior's Entrance
description: When you land, you and your minions gain additional melee damage and spell damage for 3 seconds. This buff can stack.

fl13-2.name: Brutal Impact
description: Fury Leap's critical strikes deal more damage.

fl13-8.name: Frenzied Onslaught
description: When you land, you and your minions gain {Frenzy} for 3 seconds, which increases attack and cast speed. Frenzy cannot stack.

fl13-16.name: Savage Impact
description: Fury Leap deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you leech a portion of the damage it deals as health.

sa36oh-10.name: Opportunistic Hunter
description: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike multiplier.

sa36oh-25.name: Hunter's Trail
stats: You gain Haste when your Sabertooth Leaps
description: When your sabertooth leaps you gain {Haste} for a duration.

sa36oh-22.name: Heavy Paws
description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but your Sabertooth can no longer leap.

sa36oh-12.name: Agile and Deadly
description: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed.

sa36oh-16.name: Frost Fang
description: Your sabertooth deals additional cold damage with spells and melee attacks.

sa36oh-28.name: Ancestral Hunter
description: Your sabertooth's hits now have a chance to summon an {Ancestral Sabertooth} that attacks nearby enemies for a short duration. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 5 seconds.

sa36oh-4.name: Shatterhide
description: All physical damage dealt to your sabertooth is converted to cold damage. Consequently it is reduced by cold resistance, but not by physical resistance.

sa36oh-2.name: Prowling Juggernaut
description: Your sabertooth has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and recovers a percentage of its maximum health when it leaps.

sa36oh-14.name: From the Brink
description: While your sabertooth is on low health it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage it deals as health.
reminderText: Low health is defined as below 35% of maximum health.

sa36oh-23.name: Destructive Power
notScalingStats: Halved Chance with Multiple Fault Lines
description:
Your sabertooth's attacks which hit at least one enemy have a chance to trigger {Upheaval}. Upheaval cast in this way uses your sabertooth's stats, but your Upheaval tree.

This chance is halved if Upheaval creates multiple fault lines.
reminderText: If Upheaval creates totems, those totems still count as created by you, using your minion stats.

sa36oh-21.name: Northwind
description: Your sabertooth deals additional cold melee damage based on your dexterity.
reminderText: This includes abilities granted from this tree.

sa36oh-24.name: Earthshaking Entrance
description: When your sabertooth leaps, it uses {Upheaval} when it lands

sa36oh-6.name: Camouflage
description: Your sabertooth has more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it gains additional dodge rating for each point of Dexterity you have.
reminderText: This scales with your dexterity, not the dexterity of your sabertooth.

sa36oh-7.name: Savage Catalyst
description: When your sabertooth directly uses a melee attack and hits at least one target it has a chance to use {Flurry Swipes}.

sa36oh-26.name: Cornered Beast
stats: +100% Flurry Swipes Crit Chance if You or Sabertooth are below 50% Health
description: Your sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} inflict Bleed on hit and if you or your Sabertoth are below half health it always crits.
reminderText: This scales with your dexterity, not the dexterity of your sabertooth.

sa36oh-5.name: Ferocity
description: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with {Flurry Swipes}.

sa36oh-3.name: Frozen Fur
description: Your sabertooth has additional cold resistance and it has a chance to chill attackers that hit it. It also has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sa36oh-18.name: Rhyme Heart
description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of chill on the target.

sa36oh-27.name: Ancestral Favor
stats: Attunement Scaling Equivalent to Strength Scaling
description: Your ancestral sabertooths have increased duration per point of your attunement. Additionally, your sabertooth gains attunement scaling equivalent to its strength scaling.

sa36oh-17.name: Ice Tiger
description:
Your sabertooth becomes an {Ice Tiger}, converting 100% of its base melee physical damage to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not with increases to physical damage. The ice tiger's melee attacks have a freeze rate equal to twice their base damage.

All bleed chance is converted to frostbite chance for your ice tiger.

The ice tiger's melee attacks' {Physical} tags are swapped for {Cold} tags.

sa36oh-30.name: Gouging Claws
description: Your sabertooth's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred armor.

sa36oh-19.name: Ice Bringer
description: Your sabertooth has a chance to inflict frostbite and chill on hit.

sa36oh-9.name: Keen Senses
description: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike chance.

sa36oh-15.name: Patient Predator
description: Your sabertooth deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sa36oh-20.name: King of the Tundra
description: Your sabertooth has additional Freeze Rate Multiplier and it has more Freeze Rate per stack of Chill on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers)

sa36oh-13.name: Frenzy
description: Your sabertooth gains Frenzy for 2 seconds after using {Flurry Swipes}.

sa36oh-29.name: Ancient Bond
description: Your sabertooth's hits have a higher chance to summon {Ancestral Sabertooths} and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sa36oh-8.name: Sabermaw
description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its melee attacks have increased area.

Primalist-31.name: Exemplar
notScalingStats: +1 Max Companions at 100+ Combined Strength and Dexterity

Primalist-55.name: Predator
description: You have additional dexterity and increased movement speed.

Primalist-12.name: Ursine Strength
description: You have additional strength and take less damage from nearby enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: Each point of strength increases armour by 4% and improves skills that rely on the raw strength of you and your companions, such as Swipe and Summon Wolf.

Primalist-21.name: Cry of the Lynx
notScalingStats: Casting Companion Abilities Grants Aspect Of The Lynx
description:
You and your companions have an increased chance to critically strike. 

When you use a companion ability, you and your companions are granted {Aspect of the Lynx} for a duration, a buff that grants +5% critical strike chance and 100% increased stun chance.

Primalist-28.name: Serrated Claws
stats: +10% Aspect Of The Lynx Critical Multiplier
notScalingStats: +3% Aspect Of The Lynx Health Leech on Crit
description: You and your companions' critical strikes deal more damage, and {Aspect of the Lynx} now also grants critical strike damage.

Primalist-67.name: Weathered Elements
description: Your companions deal increased damage, and you and your minions have additional elemental resistance.

Primalist-34.name: Ancient Might
stats: +3% Shared Reduced Bonus Damage Taken From Crits
description: You have additional health, and your minions have increased health. Additionally, you and your companions take reduced bonus damage from critical strikes.
reminderText: Each point of strength increases armour by 4% and improves skills that rely the raw strength of you and your companions, such as Fury Leap and Summon Wolf.

Primalist-20.name: Hawk Wings
description: You and your minions have increased dodge rating, and you and your minions have a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second on hit.

Primalist-33.name: Primal Aspects
stats: +1% Damage Redirected to Highest Health Minion
description: Your companions receive increased effect from your {Aspects}, and a percentage of all damage taken is redirected to your highest health minion.

Primalist-109.name: Ocean Maw
stats: 10% Increased Aspect Of The Shark Duration
description: {Aspect of the Shark} is more effective and lasts longer.

Primalist-32.name: Natural Bond
description:
You are limited to only one companion.

Your companion is granted more health and deals more damage (both effects are multiplicative with other modifiers).

Primalist-58.name: Viper Fangs
stats: 3% Aspect Of The Viper Chance On Hit
description:
You and your companions have increased melee attack speed.

When you hit an enemy, you have a chance for you and your companions to be granted {Aspect of the Viper} for 3 seconds, a buff that grants 100% chance to poison on hit and 20% more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Primalist-57.name: The Circle Of Life
stats: 5% Aspect Of The Shark Chance on Kill or Boss or Rare Hit
description: You gain health and have a chance to be granted {Aspect Of The Shark} for 3 seconds whenever you kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy.
reminderText: {Aspect of the Shark} grants 10% more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increases melee attack speed by 10%.

Primalist-19.name: Boar Heart
stats: 1 Aspect of The Boar Duration on Traversal or Evade (Seconds)
description: You are granted {Aspect of the Boar} for a duration when you use a traversal skill or Evade, a buff that grants 30% increased bleed duration and reduces damage taken by 15%. This effect has a 2 second cooldown. You also have additional endurance.

Primalist-24.name: Call of the Pack
stats: 20 Heal Amount On Companion Ability Use
description: You and your companions have additional health, and you and your companions are healed whenever you use a companion ability.
reminderText:
The health restored is affected by increased healing effectiveness.

This effect does not trigger when your companions abilities are triggered automatically.

Primalist-15.name: Ambush
stats: Aspect Of The Shark Granted On Melee Attack
description: Every 5 seconds, your next melee attack deals increased damage and grants {Aspect of the Shark} for 3 seconds, a buff that grants 10% more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increases melee attack speed by 10%.

Primalist-26.name: Rattlesnake
stats: 15% Increased Aspect Of The Viper Duration
+4% Poison Penetration with Aspects of the Viper
description: {Aspect of the Viper} lasts longer and grants you Poison Penetration.

Primalist-30.name: Feeding Frenzy
stats: 5 Max Aspect Of The Shark Stacks
-60% Less Aspect Of The Shark Effect
description: {Aspect of the Shark} can now stack up to 5 times, but it is significantly less effective (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Primalist-56.name: Porcine Constitution
stats: 4% Aspect Of The Boar Chance On Melee Hit
description:
{Aspect of the Boar} grants additional damage reduction, and now also grants increased health regeneration.

Additionally, your hits have a chance to grant you {Aspect of the Boar}.
reminderText: {Aspect of the Boar} is a buff that grants 30% increased bleed duration and reduces damage taken by 15%.

Primalist-29.name: Avian Shelter
description: You have a higher endurance threshold and you and your minions have additional physical resistance.
reminderText: Endurance reduces the damage you take below your endurance threshold. You have a base Endurance Threshold of 20% of your maximum health. Endurance is capped at 60%.

Primalist-59.name: Embodiment
stats: Companions Gain Shark Or Boar Aspects When You Do
description: All {Aspects} have increased duration, and you have additional health.
reminderText: Whenever a companion gains an Aspect, it benefits from your increased Aspect effect and duration.

Primalist-27.name: Life in the Wilderness
notScalingStats: Your Endurance And Endurance Threshold Apply to Companions
description: You have additional vitality and a higher endurance threshold.
reminderText:
Each point of vitality grants 6 health and 1% poison and necrotic resistance.

Endurance reduces the damage you take below your endurance threshold. You have a base Endurance Threshold of 20% of your maximum health. Endurance is capped at 60%.

Primalist-22.name: The Chase
notScalingStats: 4 Companion Damage Immunity Duration After Revive (seconds)

Primalist-25.name: Rending Maw
stats: +20% Aspect Of The Shark Armour Shred Chance
description: {Aspect of the Shark} also grants attacks and spells a chance to reduce enemy armor.

Primalist-18.name: Tusk Warrior
description: {Aspect of the Boar} also grants a chance for attacks and spells to cause enemies to bleed and physical penetration with bleed.

Primalist-14.name: Artor's Loyalty
description:
You are limited to a single companion.

Your companion is larger and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wo42-18.name: Stormborn
description: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit or when they hit an enemy.
reminderText: {Storm Bolts} cast by your Wolves are affected by your {Gathering Storm} tree and scale with minion damage.

wo42-30.name: Lone Wolf
notScalingStats: You can only have one active Wolf
Summon Wolf becomes Howl with only one active Wolf
description: While you have the additional wolf from {Permanent Bond} summoned, Summon Wolf is replaced with {Howl}, but you cannot have more than one wolf summoned at a time.

wo42-28.name: Crippling Wounds
description: Bleed inflicted by Wolves lasts longer and wolves have a chance to slow on hit and when hit.

wo42-19.name: Lupine Endurance
description: Your Wolves have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wo42-2.name: Canine Agility
description: Your Wolves have additional dodge chance, and have increased dodge rating for each point of strength you have.

wo42-11.name: Permanent Bond
description: You have an additional wolf companion at all times. This wolf does not count towards your companion limit.

wo42-20.name: Storm Caller's Reprisal
description: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit, and deal more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: {Storm Bolts} cast by your Wolves are affected by your {Gathering Storm} tree and scale with minion damage.

wo42-12.name: Earthborn
description: Wolves have additional armor, and their attacks leech a portion of the physical damage they deal as health.

wo42-25.name: Relentless
description: Your Wolves cannot be stunned.

wo42-26.name: Battlecry
description: The buffs granted by {Howl} last longer and wolves have a chance to Howl when they hit a rare or boss enemy. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

wo42-5.name: Serrated Claws
description: Wolves have a chance to cause enemies to bleed with their melee attacks.

wo42-10.name: Legendary Bite
description: Your Wolves' melee hits deal more damage, have a greater chance to stun (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has improved base critical strike chance, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wo42-21.name: Cloud Runners
description: Your Wolves deal more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wo42-6.name: Patient Hunters
description: Wolves deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and bleed they inflict has additional Physical Penetration.

wo42-13.name: Winterborn
description: Wolves have a chance to chill enemies on hit.

wo42-23.name: Shaman's Bond
description: Your Wolves now deal increase damage and have increased health for each point of Attunement you have.
reminderText: This scales with your attunement, not the attunement of your wolves.

wo42-17.name: Safety In Numbers
description: You can summon Wolves up to your maximum number of companions.
reminderText: When you cast Summon Wolf, you will summon wolves up to your companion limit.

wo42-22.name: Storm Jaws
description: Your Wolves' melee attacks deal additional lightning damage.

wo42-27.name: Call of the Wind
description: Your Wolves' {Howl} also grant {Haste} for a short duration.

wo42-9.name: Savage Hunters
description: Wolves deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wo42-7.name: Snarl
description:
When you kill an enemy one of your Wolves has a chance to {Howl}. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

Howl also grants more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed to all affected allies.

wo42-4.name: Victory Howl
description: Wolves have a chance to {Howl} on kill. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

wo42-3.name: Leap Attack
description: Your Wolves gain a {Leap Attack} to close the gap on distant enemies. Leap Attack has a 10 second cooldown.

wo42-29.name: Frozen Fangs
description:
Your Wolves gain the {Ice Bite} ability, which deals higher damage in a larger area, with a 6 second cooldown. 20% of the remaining cooldown is recovered every time the Wolf hits with an ability other than Ice Bite, including their basic attack.

Ice Bite deals melee cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with your wolves' increases to melee and cold damage, but not increases to their physical damage.
reminderText: Ice Bite has 100% increased radius relative to the wolves' basic attack.

wo42-8.name: On the Hunt
description: Wolves have increased attack and move speed.

wo42-16.name: Wolfen Recovery
description: Wolves have additional base health regeneration and increased health regeneration.

wo42-14.name: Tundra Stalkers
description: Wolves deal additional cold damage with attacks, and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

wo42-24.name: Howl of Might
description: Wolves have more damage and dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is tripled for Wolves that have used {Howl} recently.
reminderText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds

st38ml-8.name: Grounding Conduit
description: You deal increased lightning damage if a Storm Totem has hit a shocked an enemy recently.

st38ml-5.name: Fulgurite Core
stats: +1 Spell Lightning Damage per 10% Shock Chance
+1 Spell Lightning Damage per 10% Chance to Shock Attackers
description: Storm Totem has additional Spell Lightning Damage based on your Shock Chance and your Chance to Shock Attackers.
reminderText: The totem's shock chance and your shock chance for minions are not taken into account, just your own shock chance. The same applies for the chance to shock attackers.

st38ml-13.name: Lightning Raider
description: Storm Totem has more cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

st38ml-2.name: Static Field
description: Storm Totem attacks have a chance to shock enemies.

st38ml-23.name: Discharge
description: Storm Totem casts {Lightning Nova} when it dies.
reminderText: {Lightning Nova} scales with your minion's stats.

st38ml-18.name: Chill to the Bone
description: Storm Totem hits have a chance to chill enemies.

st38ml-3.name: Exploit Weaknesses
description: Storm Totem hits deal more damage to shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

st38ml-21.name: Storm's Reach
description: Storm Totem's individual lightning strikes damage enemies in a larger area
reminderText: If you have the {Blizzard} node this affects the area of the blizzard.

st38ml-20.name: Piercing Winds
description: {Frostbite} inflicted by {Blizzard} has additional Cold Penetration.

st38ml-6.name: Overstimulation
description: Enemies hit by Storm Totem recently have reduced movement speed.

st38ml-14.name: Direct Current
description: Improves Storm Totem's base critical strike chance.

st38ml-17.name: Icicles
description: Storm Totem deals additional cold spell damage.

st38ml-9.name: Shielding Totem
description: Allies near your Storm Totem have additional lightning resistance.

st38ml-7.name: Stormrider
description: You have increased movement speed if Storm Totem has hit a shocked enemy recently (last 4 seconds).

st38ml-25.name: Thunder Totem
stats: +20% Thunder Totem Damage, Health, Duration And Size Per Totem
description:
If you have at least 3 other totems when you summon Storm Totem, up to 5 are consumed to instead summon a {Thunder Totem} which has more damage, duration, health and size per totem consumed this way (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect does not consume other Storm Totems or Thunder Totems.

st38ml-10.name: Steel Plating
description: Storm Totem has increased health.

st38ml-12.name: Limited Resistance
description: Storm Totem costs less mana to summon.

st38ml-19.name: Frostbite
description: {Blizzard} has a chance to inflict enemies with {Frostbite} each second.

st38ml-16.name: Blizzard
description:
Storm Totem now creates a {Blizzard} around itself; enemies caught in the blizzard take cold damage over time and have a 25% chance to be chilled each second.

All shock chance is converted to chill chance. All effects which are conditional on shock are conditional on chill instead.

st38ml-4.name: Press Your Advantage
stats: 10% More Crit Chance Against Shocked Enemies
description: Storm Totem has more critical strike chance against shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

st38ml-26.name: Unmatched Storms
stats: Storm Bolts Instead Of Lightning Strikes
description: Your Storm Totem now casts {Storm Bolts} from your {Gathering Storm} instead of its own lightning strikes, but Storm Totem has significantly less cast speed and deals less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: The Storm Bolts benefit from your Storm Totem tree and your {Gathering Storm} tree.

st38ml-11.name: Heavy Impact
description: Storm Totem hits have an increased chance to stun enemies and the stuns they inflict last longer.

st38ml-15.name: Power Shunt
description: Storm Totem critical strikes deal more damage.

st38ml-24.name: Intensity
description: Storm Totem deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but cost more mana.

st38ml-22.name: Shockfury
description: Allies near your Storm Totem are granted additional melee lightning damage.

su3lem-10.name: Mana Swell
description: Your tide elemental has additional critical strike chance based on your maximum mana.

su3lem-16.name: Tidal Pools
stats: +10% Geyser Chance to Repeat from Totems
description: {Geyser} has a chance to repeat from each totem within 12 meters. Each cast can hit the same enemy.
reminderText: Repeated casts can't trigger additional repeats.

su3lem-13.name: Backflow
description:
{Elemental Bolt}'s projectiles are fired in a nova, targeting enemies within 12 meters.

Elemental Bolt fires additional projectiles, but your tide elemental has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su3lem-8.name: King Tide
description: Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su3lem-11.name: Riptide
description: Your tide elemental has increased cast speed and movement speed.

su3lem-21.name: Twin Twisters
notScalingStats: 4 Minimum Tornado Distance from Tide Elemental (meters)
description: Whenever you create a {Tornado} at least 4 meters away from your tide elemental, you have a chance to create a Tornado at your tide elemental's location as well.
reminderText: The Tornado is still cast by you, not your tide elemental. The Tornado is instantly redirected by {Water Spout}.

su3lem-1.name: Erosion
description: Your tide elemental has a chance to shred cold resistance on hit.

su3lem-14.name: Elemental Fury
stats: 5% Increased Cast Speed per Elemental Fury
description:
When your tide elemental directly casts {Elemental Bolt} it gains {Elemental Fury} for 4 seconds, stacking up to a maximum.

Each stack of Elemental Fury grants increased cast speed for Elemental Bolt.
reminderText: All stacks of Elemental Fury have their duration refreshed whenever a stack is gained.

su3lem-25.name: Pools of Reverence
description: {Wellspring}'s buffs are significantly more effective on totems (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it no longer affects players.

su3lem-4.name: Thunder Elemental
stats: Cold Resistance Shred -> Lightning Res Shred
description:
Your tide elemental becomes a {Thunder Elemental}. The base cold damage of your tide elemental's spells are converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to cold damage.

Frostbite chance and cold resistance shred from all sources are converted to shock chance and lightning resistance shred, respectively.

Your tide elemental gains additional critical strike multiplier.
reminderText: This node has no effect if {Wind Elemental} is allocated.

su3lem-23.name: Return to Seafoam
description:
If your tide elemental dies, its cooldown is reset.

Your tide elemental has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su3lem-30.name: Whirlpools
stats: +25% Chance to gain Maelstrom when you do
description: Your tide elemental has a chance to cast {Maelstrom} whenever you do. Maelstroms cast by your tide elemental in this way use your tide elemental's stats, but your Maelstrom tree.
reminderText: Your tide elemental will only cast Maelstrom on itself, not others.

su3lem-29.name: Northern Seas
description:
Your tide elemental has a chance to inflict frostbite on hit.

This effect is doubled with at least 80 attunement.

su3lem-26.name: Bird Bath
stats: +25% Wellspring Chain Chance for Storm Crows
description: {Wellspring} grants Storm Crows a chance to chain to two additional enemies with their basic lightning spell.

su3lem-18.name: Ocean Currents
description: {Geyser} has increased cooldown recovery speed.

su3lem-2.name: Wellspring
description: Your tide elemental gains {Wellspring}, an aura that grants additional cold spell damage and increased cast speed to allies within 18 meters.
reminderText:
Wellspring affects all allies, including itself. If your tide elemental's damage is converted, the additional spell damage from Wellspring is also converted.
If there are multiple tide elementals, only the strongest Wellspring applies.

su3lem-19.name: Artesian Well
notScalingStats: 8 Mana Consumed per Cast of Elemental Bolt from Geyser
description: While you are above half mana, {Geyser} consumes your mana to also cast {Elemental Bolt} a number of times from its location, targeting enemies within 12 meters.

su3lem-7.name: Tidal Totem
description:
Your tide elemental is now a totem. It cannot move, but is affected by totem modifiers.

Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: This also prevents Geyser from moving your tide elemental.

su3lem-27.name: Cove of Gulls
description: Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per active {Storm Crow}.

su3lem-5.name: Unleashed Elements
stats: Elemental Fury Consumed at Max Stacks
Projectiles Fired in Volley When Consuming Stacks
description:
When your tide elemental directly casts {Elemental Bolt} while at maximum stacks of {Elemental Fury}, it consumes all stacks to gain an additional projectile per stack.

Elemental Bolt cast this way fires its projectiles in a tight volley, and can hit the same target multiple times.

su3lem-17.name: Azure Expanse
description: Your tide elemental's {Geyser} has increased area of effect.

su3lem-24.name: Harmony of Water
stats: +0.5% Wellspring Effect on Players per Attunement
description: {Wellspring}'s buffs have increased effect on players based on your attunement.

su3lem-9.name: Crashing Waves
description: Your tide elemental has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier.

su3lem-22.name: Crimson Harbor
stats: 1% Increased Health Regen per your Increased Mana Regen
description:
Your tide elemental gains a percentage of your increased mana regeneration as increased health regeneration.

It also gains additional health regeneration.

su3lem-28.name: Seahenge
stats: Totems Move to Summoned Tide Elemental
description:
When you summon your tide elemental, your totems are moved to surround it.

Totems that were moved gain additional duration, up to a maximum.

su3lem-20.name: Water Spout
description: When one of your {Tornadoes} hits your tide elemental, the tide elemental redirects it towards an enemy within 12 meters and grants the tornado more damage and speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for a duration.
reminderText: A Tornado can only be redirected by a tide elemental once. Stationary Tornadoes can't be moved.

su3lem-3.name: Wind Elemental
stats: Cold Resistance Shred -> Physical Resistance Shred
description:
Your tide elemental becomes a {Wind Elemental}. The base cold damage of your tide elemental's spells are converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not with increases to cold damage.

Frostbite chance and cold resistance shred from all sources are converted to frailty chance and physical resistance shred, respectively.

Your tide elemental gains additional dodge rating.

su3lem-6.name: Resurgence
description:
Summon Tide Elemental no longer has a cooldown, but it costs additional mana.

The {Geyser} that occurs when casting Summon Tide Elemental deals more damage and has more area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: This only affects the Geyser created when casting Summon Tide Elemental, not when your tide elemental would otherwise cast Geyser.

su3lem-12.name: Wake
description: Your tide elemental's {Elemental Bolt} fires additional projectiles in a cone.
reminderText: Elemental Bolt's projectiles cannot hit the same target more than once per cast.

su3lem-15.name: High Tide
description: Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) the longer it has remained alive, up to a maximum.

Primalist-118.name: Primordial Resonance
reminderText: Penetration can bring enemies below 0% resistance, causing them to take more damage. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.

Primalist-79.name: Wind in the Leaves
description: Increases the attack and cast speed of you and your minions.

Primalist-112.name: Piercing Gale
notScalingStats: 16% Increased Locusts Attack, Cast And Move Speed
16% Increased Crows Attack, Cast And Move Speed
description: You and your minions have additional cold penetration.
reminderText: Penetration can bring enemies below 0% resistance, causing them to take more damage. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.

Primalist-76.name: Nightshade Fangs
description: Your melee attacks have a chance to inflict Bleed on hit and your spells have a chance to inflict Poison on hit.

Primalist-72.name: Blossoming Garden
notScalingStats: Eterra's Blessing On Nearby Ally On Spell Or Movement Skill Use
description: Increases healing effectiveness for you and your minions.
reminderText: Increased healing effectiveness increases the health restored by healing skills and effects.

Primalist-104.name: Hideskin
stats: +1% Maximum Health Gained As Endurance Threshold
description: You have additional health and gain a percentage of your maximum health as endurance threshold.
reminderText: Endurance reduces the damage you take below your endurance threshold. You have a base Endurance Threshold of 20% of your maximum health. Endurance is capped at 60%.

Primalist-90.name: Force of Nature
description: You and your minions deal additional physical damage with spells and melee attacks.

Primalist-74.name: Fetid Resilience
stats: 7% Increased Damage Over Time While Transformed
3% Less Damage Over Time Taken In Human Form
description: You deal increased damage over time while transformed and take less damage over time in human form (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Primalist-94.name: Impervious
notScalingStats: 4% Less Hit Damage Taken Per Stack
Lose All Stacks After 10 Seconds Of Inactivity
description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to grant you a stack of {Impervious} causing you to take less damage from hits (multiplicative with other modifiers), but you lose a stack when you are hit and you lose all stacks after 10 seconds of not gaining any stacks.

Primalist-80.name: Totemic Restoration
notScalingStats: 10% Chance To Summon Healing Totem When Hit
reminderText: Increased healing effectiveness increases the health restored by healing skills and effects.

Primalist-85.name: Reincarnation
stats: 100 Healing For You And Your Minions On Transform
notScalingStats: Shapeshifter Applies To Minions On Transform
description: You and your minions are healed when you transform. This scales with increases to healing effectiveness.

Primalist-84.name: Woodland Beings
reminderText: Increased healing effectiveness increases the health restored by healing skills and effects.

Primalist-93.name: Primal Shifter
description: You gain the {Shapeshifter} buff for a limited duration when you transform, granting you increased armor and damage.

Primalist-98.name: Blessed Springs
description: Increases cold damage and healing effectiveness for you and your minions.
reminderText: Increased healing effectiveness increases the health restored by healing skills and effects. It does not affect other sources of health gain such as health leech or health regen.

Primalist-91.name: Eternal Nature
description: You and your companions have additional spell damage.

Primalist-92.name: Tiger Spirit
description: You have increased critical strike chance and multiplier while you have the {Shapeshifter} buff.

Primalist-81.name: Focused Wrath
description: You deal increased damage while transformed and your rage decays slower.

Primalist-78.name: Natural Duality
stats: 30% Increased Damage With An Active Companion
description: You are limitted to one companion, but that companion has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers). If you control a companion you deal increased damage and have additional armour.

Primalist-111.name: Aspects of Might
notScalingStats: 1% Increased Armor Per Strength In Human Or Spriggan
1% Increased Melee Damage Per Strength In Bear Or Swarmblade

Primalist-110.name: Rancour
stats: No Rage Decay Out Of Combat
description: Your rage only decays if you have used an ability recently (past 4 seconds).

Primalist-89.name: Chitinous Plating
reminderText:
Endurance reduces the damage you take below your endurance threshold. You have a base Endurance Threshold of 20% of your maximum health. Endurance is capped at 60%.

Locusts are minions that can be summoned in Swarmblade Form.

Primalist-100.name: Toxic Reach
notScalingStats: 36% Chance To Summon A Vine On Kill
description: Your and your minions' hits have a chance to poison.

Primalist-71.name: Spirit Warden
notScalingStats: Mana Or Rage Cost As Health On Spell Cast

Primalist-77.name: Thicket of Thorns
stats: +2% Chance To Cast Thorn Shield On You When Hit
description: You have a chance to cast {Thorn Shield} on yourself when you are hit and you have increased armor and reflect damage back to attackers.
reminderText: Thorn Shield is a Spriggan Form skill. it can be modified by nodes on the Spriggan Form tree.

av75ch-20.name: Frost
stats: Increased Stun Chance -> Freeze Rate Multiplier
description: Avalanche's base physical damage is converted to cold damage, and increased stun chance provided by this tree is converted to freeze rate multiplier.
reminderText: If you have this node and Rockfall, then the Rockfall node has no effect.

av75ch-13.name: Storm Slide
stats: +10 Lightning Damage In Range Of Storm Totem
description: While in range of a {Storm Totem}, Avalanche hits deal additional lightning damage.

av75ch-12.name: Grounding
description: Avalanche hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have at least one active totem.

av75ch-16.name: Snow Storm
description:
Avalanche drops additional small boulders.

If Avalanche is channeled, small boulders drop more frequently instead.

av75ch-4.name: Crater
description:
Avalanche's every third large boulder creates an {Earthquake} on impact.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Earthquake's} mana cost.

av75ch-6.name: Hailstorm
description:
The persisting Avalanche is now cast around you and follows your movement.

The large boulders will automatically target enemies within 6 meters.

av75ch-5.name: Naturally Occuring
description: Avalanche costs less mana.

av75ch-10.name: Excavation
description:
Avalanche hits have an increased chance to stun enemies.

Additionally, the impact from the large boulders have a chance to create your {Upheaval} towards a nearby enemy.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Upheaval's} mana cost.

av75ch-2.name: Mountain Peak
description: Avalanche is now channeled, creating 1 large boulder and 5 small boulders every second, but has a channeling cost every second.

av75ch-15.name: Intensity
description: Small boulders have a chance to be replaced by large boulders.

av75ch-7.name: Unyielding Storm
description: Avalance now persists after you stop channeling for a duration equal to twice as long as you spent channeling, up to a maximum.

av75ch-11.name: Winter Buildup
description:
Avalanche costs less mana.

If it's channeled, it will reduce the channel cost instead.

av75ch-22.name: Frosted Font
description:
{Frozen Ground} affects a larger area.

You and your allies standing on your {Frozen Ground} gain a chance to inflict frostbite on hit.

av75ch-9.name: Rockfall
stats: Freeze Rate Multiplier -> Increased Stun Chance
description: Avalanche's base cold damage is converted to physical damage, and freeze rate multiplier bonuses from this tree are converted to increased stun chance.
reminderText: If you have this and Frost, this node has no effect.

av75ch-24.name: Explosive Impact
description: Avalanche boulders fall in a larger area, and each boulder has a larger area of impact.

av75ch-19.name: Dead of Winter
description: Avalanche hits have an increased chance to freeze enemies.

av75ch-23.name: Shatter Shot
description:
Avalanche hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against frozen enemies.

av75ch-25.name: Mountain's Fury
description: Avalanche boulders have a larger area of impact.

av75ch-14.name: Stormcaller
description: Boulder hits have a chance to grant you a {Storm Stack}.

av75ch-8.name: Harsh Winter
description: Avalanche deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

av75ch-28.name: Absorption
description: When a {Coldstone Elemental} is hit by a boulder, they regain health and gain {Frenzy} and {Haste} for a short duration.

av75ch-27.name: Elemental Bond
description:
Large boulders have a chance to form into a {Coldstone Elemental}, which is a melee minion that deals cold and physical damage and decays over time.

You can summon up to 9 {Coldstone Elementals}, and summoning past this maximum will refresh the decay and health of the most decayed one.

av75ch-21.name: Frost Touch
stats: 50% Large Boulder Chance To Leave Frozen Ground
description: Avalanche's large boulders have a chance to leave behind {Frozen Ground,} which chills all enemies who stand on it.

av75ch-26.name: Unpredictability
description: Boulders fall in a larger area. This reduces your chance to hit single targets.

av75ch-17.name: Pummeling
description:
Large boulders will cause a {Fissure} to open underneath them, dealing physical damage over 4 seconds to enemies who stand on it.

You can have a maximum of 1 {Fissure} at a time.

av75ch-18.name: Alpine Guide
description:
Improves Avalanche's base critical strike chance.

When a large boulder critically strikes, it has a chance to drop a small boulder at the same location.

av75ch-3.name: Precision
description: Small boulders now fall in a smaller area up to a maximum, causing them to hit more precisely at the target location.

to50-11.name: Overcast Skies
description: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from further away.
reminderText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

to50-4.name: Hurricane
description: When you directly use Tornado, you have a chance to create an additional Tornado, but Tornadoes have reduced pull strength.

to50-21.name: Snap Gale
description: Tornado is now instant cast and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now has a 4 second cooldown.
reminderText: If Tornado is a channelled skill, this node does not make it cast instantly, but the damage modifier and cooldown still apply.

to50-10.name: Eye of the Storm
stats: Can No Longer Cast Additional Tornadoes
description: Tornado deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and attach to you wherever you move, but you can no longer cast additional Tornadoes at once.

to50-16.name: Stormbringer
description: Tornado has increased cast speed and area of effect.

to50-20.name: Swift Wings
description: {Aspect of the Storm} lasts longer.

to50-14.name: Igniting Swirl
description: Tornado ignites nearby enemies every second.

to50-8.name: Fire Tornado
description:
Tornados' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: Fire tornado scales with increases to fire damage, not physical damage.

to50-18.name: Storm Dervish
stats: +7% Aspect of the Storm Attack Speed
+7% Aspect of the Storm Cast Speed
description: {Aspect of the Storm} now also grants increased attack and cast speed.

to50-24.name: Shelter of the Storm
description: While channelling Tornado you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and have increased dodge rating.

to50-19.name: Gust of Renewal
stats: +3% Aspect of the Storm Mana Regen
description: Tornado costs less mana, and {Aspect of the Storm} grants increased mana regeneration.

to50-7.name: Debris
description: Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

to50-23.name: Voices of the Wind
description: Tornado is now a channelled skill, sustaining a single tornado that follows your cursor. This tornado deals much more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased area of effect. Modifiers to duration affect its damage instead.
reminderText: Modifiers for the channelled tornado do not apply to indirect casts of tornado.

to50-12.name: Churning Orbs
description: Tornado now create a {Storm Orb} every second, but Tornado has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: Storm orbs explode after one second dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.\n\nStorm orbs scale with increases to physical damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

to50-3.name: Strength of Air
description: Tornado has increased pull strength.

to50-5.name: Charged Storm
description: Tornado casts {Storm Bolt} at an enemy within 5 meters every 2 seconds.
reminderText: Affected by modifiers to Storm Bolt, including its targeting area.

to50-9.name: Druidic Control
description: Tornado is now stationary, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

to50-13.name: Trail of Storms
description: Tornadoes cast {Storm Orbs} more frequently.

to50-2.name: Lasting Storm
description: Tornado lasts longer.

to50-15.name: Inferno
stats: 50% Ignite Chance On Hit -> Ignite Chance Per Second
description: Tornado gains a portion of your chance to ignite with fire spells as ignite chance per second.

to50-22.name: Storm Soul
description: Tornado has a shorter cooldown and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

to50-6.name: Frequent Lightning
description: Tornado casts {Storm Bolt} more frequently.
reminderText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

to50-17.name: Aspect of the Storm
description: Casting Tornado grants {Aspect of the Storm} for 2 seconds, which grants 10% increased movespeed.
reminderText: You can only have one instance of Aspect of the Storm at once.

be36ar-25.name: Storm Beast
description:
The base physical damage of your bear's melee attack is converted to lightning, and it has a {Lightning} tag instead of {Physical}.

Your bear shocks enemies on hit.

Your bear gains the ability to teleport towards enemies, on an 8 second cooldown.

be36ar-23.name: Ursine Dominion
description: Your bear's abilities have increased area of effect.

be36ar-11.name: Forceful Swipes
description:
Your bear can use {Swipe} with a 2 second cooldown. Your Bear's Swipe scales with its own stats, but is affected by your Swipe Tree.

Your bear deals additional melee physical damage per 3 points of your Strength.

be36ar-6.name: Shredding Thorns
description: {Thorn Burst} has a chance to shred armor on hit.

be36ar-14.name: Thick Hide
description: Your bear has more health and takes less damage at low health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText:
Both of these effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

Low health is defined as below 35% of maximum health.

be36ar-26.name: Mother Bear
description: Your bear's {Roar} also grants itself and your minions less damage taken for 6 seconds.

be36ar-18.name: Armored Bears
description: Your bear has additional armor based on your strength.

be36ar-15.name: Groundshaking Might
description: Your bear can use {Earthquake}, with a 6 second cooldown. When cast this way, Earthquake uses your bear's stats but your Earthquake tree. Earthquakes cast by your bear deal less damage.

be36ar-17.name: Unstoppable Force
description: Your bear takes less damage from critical strikes and its own critical strikes deal more damage.
reminderText: Both of these effects are multiplicative with other modifiers

be36ar-28.name: Guardian
stats: +5% Roar Grants Damage Taken Redirected to Highest Health Minion
description: Your bear's {Roar} also grants you a percentage of damage taken redirected to your highest health minion for 6 seconds.

be36ar-27.name: Frighten
description: Your bear's {Roar} inflicts Frailty on enemies.

be36ar-10.name: Thorn Eruption
notScalingStats: Tripled Against Bosses And Rare Enemies
description: Your bear has a chance to cast a {Thorn Burst} from each enemy hit by its {Earthquake}. This chance is tripled against bosses and rare enemies.
reminderText: An enemy can be hit by both the Earthquake and all resulting Thorn Bursts.

be36ar-4.name: Barbed Thorns
description: {Thorn Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

be36ar-2.name: Lacerating Claws
description: Your bear deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

be36ar-8.name: Bestial Fury
description: Your bear has increased attack speed.

be36ar-13.name: Vicious Strikes
description: Your bear deals more damage with Swipe (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area with Swipe.

be36ar-12.name: Rapid Swipes
description: Your bear's {Swipe} has a shorter cooldown.

be36ar-19.name: Toxic Growths
description: {Thorn Burst} has a chance to poison enemies on hit. Additionally, your bear deals more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

be36ar-7.name: Unflinching
stats: +1% Health Regen for You with Active Bear
description:
Your bear has more health regeneration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

While you have an active bear companion, you have more health regeneration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

be36ar-16.name: Primal Precision
description: Your bear has additional critical strike chance.

be36ar-22.name: Wounded Prey
description: Your bear has increased movement speed and deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target (up to 30).

be36ar-5.name: Thorned Fur
description: Your bear also releases a {Thorn Burst} when hit, up to a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

be36ar-24.name: Renewed Force
stats: Bear Earthquake Charge Restore on Warcry or Werebear
description: Your bear gains an additional charge for Earthquake. When you directly cast {Warcry} or enter {Werebear Form}, your bear restores a charge for Earthquake.
reminderText:
Werebear Form's {Roar} counts as a Warcry.
If your bear had 0 remaining charges for Earthquake and 50% cooldown remaining, after casting Warcry it will have 1 remaining charge and 50% cooldown remaining.

be36ar-9.name: Endless Rampage
description: Your bear has increased movement speed and cannot be stunned.

be36ar-3.name: Thorn Bear
description: Your bear's basic attack releases a {Thorn Burst}, a spell that deals physical damage around the bear.

be36ar-21.name: Bellowing Roar
description: Your bear's {Roar} has increased area and healing effectiveness.

Primalist-3.name: Hunter's Restoration
description: You have increased health and every 3 seconds your next hit restores your health.
reminderText:
This effect can only proc if you are not on full health.

Your "hits" do not include damage over time or minion skills

Primalist-7.name: Tempest Bond
stats: Doubled while you have a minion
description: You deal increased physical, cold, and lightning damage. These bonuses are doubled while you have an active minion.

Primalist-8.name: Hunter's Emanation
description: The healing from {Hunter's Restoration} also applies to your minions, and when you trigger Hunter's Restoration, your minions gain increased damage for 3 seconds.

Primalist-1.name: Natural Attunement
reminderText: Each point of attunement grants 2 mana and improves skills that rely on the innate magic inside you and your surroundings, such as Gathering Storm and Summon Thorn Totem.

Primalist-4.name: Primal Medicine
stats: 50% Percent Of Potion Healing Received By Minions
description: Your minions deal increased damage, and using a potion also heals your minions for a percentage of the amount it heals you.

Primalist-116.name: Ancestral Weaponry
stats: +5 Melee Cold Damage with a Two Handed Mace
+4 Melee Physical Damage with a Two Handed Axe
+3 Melee Lightning Damage with a Staff
description: You deal additional melee damage with most two handed weapons. The amount and damage type depend on the type of weapon used.

Primalist-0.name: Primal Strength
reminderText: Each point of strength increases armour by 4% and improves skills that rely on the raw strength of you and your companions, such as Swipe and Summon Wolf.

Primalist-86.name: Rotbane
notScalingStats: Totems Are Immune To Poison Damage

Primalist-115.name: Elder Branch
description: You and your totems deal additional spell damage. This bonus is tripled while using an axe.

Primalist-10.name: Harmony of Blades
stats: +20% Attack And Cast Speed While Dual Wielding
description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping an axe or sword in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Primalist-5.name: Survival of the Pack
stats: 0.5% Minion Melee Damage Leeched as Health

Primalist-114.name: Cornered Beast
stats: 15% More Melee Damage on Low Health
4% Less Damage Taken on Low Health
description:
While at low health (below 35%) you take less damage and deal more melee damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when damage leaves you at low health you gain these benefits for 5 seconds if you aren't already at low health.

uph41-5.name: Glacial Cascade
description:
Upheaval's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Upheaval has a chance to freeze enemies on hit.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and slow chance from all sources is converted to chill chance.

uph41-11.name: Mountain Fortress
description: You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval Totem and you have an additional charge.

uph41-4.name: Erupting Earth
description: Upheaval now travels in 5 fault lines in a star around you.

uph41-23.name: Natural Weapons
description: Upheaval has increased area while using a mace, additional bleed chance while using an axe and additional cold penetration while using a staff.

uph41-30.name: Upheaval Totems
description:
You now create an {Upheaval Totem} that attacks with Upheaval from it rather than yourself. You are limited to 1 of these totems. Upheaval now has a cooldown and costs significantly more mana.

Upheaval Totems last 8 seconds.
reminderText: Upheaval Totems are minions, meaning they are affected by minion modifiers instead of your damage stats.

uph41-8.name: Mantle Strike
description: Improves Upheaval's base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.

uph41-7.name: Inexhaustible
description: Upheaval costs less mana and has a chance to shred enemy armor.

uph41-20.name: Terraforming Clash
description: Upheaval travels further.

uph41-0.name: Upheaval
description: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.

uph41-2.name: Tremblor
notScalingStats: Buff To Next Fury Leap Or Earthquake
description: When you directly use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Shattering} up to a maximum, causing your next {Fury Leap} or {Earthquake} to consume all stacks to gain additional physical penetration and increased area per stack consumed.
reminderText: This has no effect if Upheaval is used by a totem.

uph41-25.name: Brutish Engagement
description: Upheaval deals more melee damage to enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on how close they are to you, up to a maximum.
reminderText:
This is fully effective within 2 meters and has no effect after 6 meters. 
This is based on your distance to the enemy, even with {Upheaval Totems}.

uph41-26.name: Hindering Tremors
description: Upheaval hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies and it penetrates enemy physical resistance, but travels a shorter distance.
reminderText: The physical penetration is affected by conversions to Upheaval's base damage.

uph41-18.name: Primal Bulwark
notScalingStats: +1 Endurance Threshold Per Attunement Per Stack
description: When you use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Armor} for 6 seconds up to a maximum amount of stacks, granting you additional armor and endurance threshold per stack of Attunement.
reminderText: This has no effect if Upheaval is used by a totem.

uph41-16.name: Maiming Rubble
description:
Upheaval hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow them.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

uph41-28.name: Master of the Totem
description: Upheaval hits grant your totems increased armor and more damage (each stack multiplicative with each other and other modifiers) for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 4 times.

uph41-12.name: Frozen Collision
description: Upheaval deals additional melee cold damage, and also deals more melee damage to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

uph41-15.name: Quarry Maker
description: Upheaval now creates additional fault lines and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

uph41-17.name: Terrain Delving
description: Upheaval deals damage in a wider area.
reminderText: This does not cause Upheaval to travel further.

uph41-6.name: Sundering Strike
description: When Upheaval hits an enemy it has a chance to release a {Shockwave}, a melee physical subskill. The Shockwave cannot hit enemies already hit by Upheaval and vice versa.
reminderText: Enemies hit by a Shockwave can not create a Shockwave, even if hit by Upheaval.

uph41-29.name: Rejuvenating Splinters
description: Upheaval and {Shockwave} hits from the {Sundering Strikes} node now {Shatter} totems, releasing shards of rock and debris dealing spell physical damage and heals you per point of Attunement.
reminderText: Upheaval Totems cannot be shattered this way.

uph41-32.name: Strengthened Roots
description: Upheaval Totems last longer, and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

uph41-19.name: Through Muck and Clay
stats: Consume Earth Armor Falling Below 6 Maelstroms
description: While you have {Earth Armor}, if you fall below 6 stacks of {Maelstrom} you consume all stacks of Earth Armor to cast Maelstrom once per stack consumed.

uph41-24.name: Unstoppable Strength
description: Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to stun enemies.

uph41-9.name: Crust Rupture
description: Upheaval critical strikes deal more damage.

uph41-14.name: Sublimation
description: You cast {Shatter} on enemies you kill with Upheaval, a spell subskill dealing cold damage in an area.

uph41-10.name: Stonethorn Pillars
stats: +30% Upheaval Totem Damage Per Totem Consumed
description: Creating an Upheaval Totem consumes all active {Thorn Totems} to grant it more damage per totem consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers). You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval totem and you have an additional charge.

uph41-22.name: Glacial Crash
description:
Upheaval penetrates enemy physical and cold resistance.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

uph41-3.name: Excavating Blow
description:
Upheaval now splits up into 3 fault lines in front of you, but Upheaval costs additional mana. Enemies can only be hit by 1 Fault Line at a time.

Upheaval Totems now have 50% less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

uph41-21.name: Earthbreaker
description:
Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but no longer scales with modifiers to attack speed.

These effects are doubled when Upheaval is directly used.

uph41-27.name: Rock Upsurge
description: When Upheaval hits your totems it has a chance to release a {Shockwave} from the totem.
reminderText: Totems hit by a Shockwave can create a Shockwave when hit by Upheaval.

uph41-13.name: Cold Front
description: Upheaval has additional freeze rate and has additional chance to inflict Frostbite on hit.

Primalist-42.name: Wind Bringer
description: You and your minions have increased cold damage, increased physical damage and additional dodge rating.

Primalist-63.name: Avatar of Thunder
notScalingStats: +2% Shared Spell Lightning Penetration Per 5 Attunement
description: You and your minions gain additional spell lightning damage.

Primalist-44.name: Hail Bringer
description: You and your minions have a chance to chill on hit, a higher chance to freeze enemies and additional cold resistance.

Primalist-39.name: Rhythm of Thunder
description: Your melee attacks deal additional lightning damage. Every 2 seconds, this effect is tripled for your next melee attack.

Primalist-41.name: Shamanic Infusion
description: You have additional attunement. You and your minions penetrate enemy physical, cold, and lightning resistances.
reminderText: Penetration can bring enemies below 0% resistance, causing them to take more damage.

Primalist-103.name: Heorot's Path
description: You and your minions have a higher chance to freeze enemies, and you have increased mana regeneration.

Primalist-61.name: Tempest Form
notScalingStats: 5 Mana Gained On Gathering Storm Hit
description: You and your minions have additional health, a chance to shock and a chance to chill on hit.

Primalist-53.name: Ascendant Circle
stats: 1% More Spell Damage With Active Totem
description: While you have an active totem you have more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Primalist-102.name: Fist of Stone
notScalingStats: 1% Increased Health Regen per 1% Uncapped Endurance
description:
You and your minions gain increased stun chance.

Additionally, you have additional Endurance.

Primalist-40.name: Silent Protector
stats: 3% Increased Mana Regen With Active Totem
description: You and your totems have additional armor while you have an active totem and you have increased mana regen while you have an active totem.

Primalist-48.name: Protective Circle
description:
You have additional physical and elemental resistance for each active totem.

Additionally, your totems have resistances against all damage types.

Primalist-43.name: Storm Bringer
description: You and your minions have increased lightning damage and additional lightning resistance.

Primalist-68.name: Thunder Strike
description: Your melee attacks have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} on hit. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.

Primalist-51.name: Glacial Strike
description: You have additional strength

Primalist-66.name: Storm Blade
stats: 1% More Melee Damage With Active Totem
description: While you have an active totem you have more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Primalist-70.name: Conflux
stats: 1% Less Damage Taken from Shocked Enemies
notScalingStats: 20% Chance for Indirect Storm Bolt Casts to Doublecast
description:
Your area skills have increased area, and you take less damage from shocked enemies.

Your totems also gain the area increases for area skills.

Primalist-60.name: Lagonian Wrath
notScalingStats: 25% Chance To Cast Storm Bolt When Hit

Primalist-49.name: Swirling Maelstrom
stats: 5% Chance To Cast Maelstrom When Hit
description:
You have additional health and mana, and have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when hit. 

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

Primalist-64.name: Shattered Heavens
description: You and your minions deal additional cold damage with spells and attacks, and your hits have a chance to inflict Frostbite.

Primalist-107.name: Ironbark
description: You have additional health and armor, and these effects are tripled for your totems.

Primalist-69.name: Lagon's Answer
stats: 8% Chance To Cast Storm Bolt On Spell Cast
20% Chance To Cast Storm Bolt Every Second While Channelling
description:
You have increased spell damage.
Your direct spell casts have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt}.
While channeling, you have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} every second.
reminderText: Triggering Storm Bolt from this node has a 1 second cooldown

Primalist-45.name: Rune of Awe
description: You and your minions have additional spell damage.

Primalist-36.name: Sky Warrior
notScalingStats: 10% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Fury Leap
10% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Crowstorm
description: You and your minions gain increased damage.

Primalist-37.name: Ancestral Speed
stats: 7% Increased Totem Attack And Cast Speed
description: Your totems have increased attack and cast speed and you have a chance to gain {Haste} for 3 seconds when you directly summon a totem.

Primalist-38.name: Totemic Fury
stats: 5% Increased Attack Speed With Active Totem
5% Increased Cast Speed With Active Totem
description: You have increased attack and cast speed while you have an active totem.

sf37-18.name: Mortuary Totem
description: While affected by Frenzy Totem, you revive downed companions faster.

sf37-19.name: Invigorated Renewal
stats: Healing Nova Cast When Companion Is Revived
description: Whenever you revive a downed companion, Frenzy Totem casts {Healing Nova.}
reminderText: The area of the Healing Nova is affected by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

sf37-25.name: Furious Cry
description: Summoning Frenzy Totem refreshes companion ability cooldowns.

sf37-13.name: Dig Deep
description: You have additional critical strike multiplier while tethered.

sf37-14.name: Revitalizing Totem
description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted increased health regeneration.

sf37-29.name: Venom Spray
description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Scorpion's {Venom Nova} hits in a larger area.

sf37-2.name: Reinforced Totem
description: Frenzy Totem has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts longer.

sf37-6.name: Improved Thorn Idol
stats: 1% Percent Of Player Damage Taken Stored By Totem
description: Frenzy Totem also stores a percentage of the damage taken by you.

sf37-3.name: Reach
description: Frenzy Totem affects allies or enemies in a larger area.

sf37-23.name: Reckless Frenzy
description: When you summon Frenzy Totem you gain a temporary buff that grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed, but also increases the damage you take.

sf37-8.name: Sloth Totem
description:
Frenzy Totem is now {Sloth Totem,} which will now slow and reduce the armor of enemies instead of granting Frenzy.

Increased effect of frenzy is converted to increased effect of armor shred.

sf37-7.name: Lash Out
description: Frenzy Totem has a chance to cast {Ice Thorns} when hit by enemies.

sf37-11.name: Totemic Reach
description: Frenzy Totem's tether has a higher range.

sf37-28.name: Lead The Pack
stats: 50% Increased Critical Strike Chance Granted By Wolf Howl
description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Wolves' howls also grant increased critical strike chance to you and your allies.

sf37-17.name: Warding Totem
description: Companions affected by Frenzy Totem have higher physical and elemental resistance.

sf37-16.name: Symbol of Selflessness
description: Frenzy Totem's buffs are more effective, but Frenzy Totem now affects only companions.

sf37-4.name: Healing Pulse
stats: 5% Chance To Cast Eterra's Blessing While In Range
description: While in range of your Frenzy Totem, you have a chance to cast {Eterra's Blessing} on a random ally each second.

sf37-9.name: Grounded
stats: Frenzy Totem Summoned 1m In Front Of Player
description:
Frenzy Totem is no longer summoned at your cursor; instead it is always placed 1 meter in the direction you're facing.

Frenzy Totem costs less mana and grants additional melee damage.

sf37-22.name: Rabidity
description: Frenzy Totem's Frenzy buff is more effective.

sf37-20.name: Venomous Intent
description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted a chance to poison enemies.

sf37-26.name: Maim
description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} casts an additional time when used.

sf37-10.name: Dig In
description: You are tethered to the totem while you remain within 5 meters of it, and while tethered you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: The range of the tether is not affected by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

sf37-24.name: Bestial Frenzy
description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, your companions are granted additional melee physical damage for 4 seconds.

sf37-15.name: Symbol of Haste
description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, you and your companions are granted {Haste} for a duration (doubled for companions).

sf37-5.name: Thorn Idol
stats: 20% Percentage Of Max Health Taken Before Releasing
description: Frenzy Totem stores a portion of the damage it receives, releasing it as damage dealt to enemies after taking a percent of its maximum health in damage.
reminderText: The damage is scaled by your increased minion damage.

mas54-14.name: Calm
description: Maelstrom costs less mana.

mas54-7.name: Tsunami
description: After every fifth Maelstrom stack gained, you release a {Tsunami}, a cold spell that deals damage in an area around you.

mas54-16.name: Cyclone
stats: +1% Global More Physical Damage Per Maelstrom Stack
description:
Maelstrom's base cold damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from this tree is converted to slow chance.

Maelstrom can no longer freeze, but each stack of Maelstrom grants global more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

mas54-15.name: Sleet-Footed
stats: 3% Increased Dodge Rating Per Maelstrom Stack
description: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you increased dodge chance.

mas54-2.name: Turmoil
description: Maelstrom deals damage in a larger area.

mas54-17.name: Whirlpool
description: Maelstrom stacks have a longer duration.

mas54-18.name: Power of the Storm
stats: Storm Bolt Cast Each Second At 6 Or More Stacks
description: While you have 6 or more stacks, you cast {Storm Bolt} at a nearby enemy each second.
reminderText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

mas54-5.name: Grip of Chaos
stats: 10% Chance for Tornado on Direct Cast
notScalingStats: 50% Percent of Tornado Mana Cost Consumed
description: When you directly cast Maelstrom, you have a chance to also cast Tornado. This consumes a percentage of Tornado's mana cost.

mas54-23.name: Windswept
description: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Haste.}

mas54-8.name: Typhoon
description: {Tsunami} deals more damage and has increased area for each stack of Maelstrom on you.

mas54-12.name: Arctic Blast
description: Maelstrom has an increased chance to freeze enemies each second.

mas54-20.name: Energized
description: {Storm Bolt} from the {Power of the Storm} node is cast at additional targets.
reminderText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

mas54-21.name: Turbulence
description: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is doubled if you have at least 60 Attunement.

mas54-3.name: Storm's Aid
description: You can choose to cast Maelstrom on your minions instead of yourself.

mas54-22.name: Growing Storm
stats: +5% Chance On Kill To Cast Maelstrom
+2% Chance On Hitting Boss Or Rare
description:
You have a chance on killing an enemy or hitting a boss or rare enemy to cast Maelstrom. 

This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

mas54-24.name: Windfury
description: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Frenzy.}

mas54-11.name: Eye of the Storm
description: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

mas54-19.name: Strong Tides
description: {Power of The Storm's} stack requirement is reduced.

mas54-4.name: Vortex
description: Maelstrom deals more damage when cast on a totem (multiplicative with other modifiers).

mas54-6.name: Arctic Chill
description: Maelstrom has a chance to chill enemies each second.

mas54-9.name: Healing Winds
description: Maelstrom also heals allies in its area of effect each second.

mas54-13.name: Beneath The Waves
notScalingStats: 1 Extra Casts per Stack of Lagon's Slumber
description: If you go one second without directly casting Maelstrom you gain a stack of {Lagon's Slumber}. When you next cast Maelstrom directly, all stacks of {Lagon's Slumber} are consumed to cast Maelstrom an additional time per stack.

mas54-10.name: Violent Squall
description: Maelstrom deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), has significantly increased healing effectiveness and lasts significantly longer, but you can have only one maximum stack of Maelstrom.

mas54-28.name: Frozen Abyss
description: Maelstrom deals more damage to chilled or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: If an enemy is chilled and frozen, both modifiers apply multiplicatively.

mas54-26.name: Essence of Debris
stats: +8% Global Increased Stun Chance Per Stack
description: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you an increased chance to stun enemies.
reminderText: Maelstrom itself cannot stun, as it is a Damage Over Time Spell.

eq5s-9.name: Buffet
description: Earthquake and its Aftershocks have an increased chance to stun enemies, and Earthquake costs less mana.

eq5s-17.name: Rupture
description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

eq5s-31.name: Shattered Resolve
description: Stuns caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks last longer, but Earthquake has a longer cooldown.

eq5s-25.name: Concussion
description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

eq5s-7.name: Divining Totem
description: Aftershocks appear around your totems instead if they are nearby.

eq5s-22.name: Sunder
description: Earthquake's initial slam reduces enemy armor.

eq5s-30.name: Staggering Force
description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage and has increased stun chance and stun duration, but Earthquake has a 6 second cooldown.

eq5s-8.name: Torpor
description: Slows caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks last longer.

eq5s-1.name: Lethargy
description: Earthquake and its {Aftershocks} have a chance to slow enemies in their area of effect.

eq5s-20.name: Seismic Smash
description: Modifiers to Aftershock damage on this tree apply to the initial slam, but Earthquake can no longer create Aftershocks.

eq5s-32.name: Deep Impact
description: Earthquake's initial slam can't be dodged.

eq5s-13.name: Dust Storm
description: Aftershocks blind enemies within their area of effect.

eq5s-10.name: Overwhelm
description: Casting Earthquake grants you {Haste} and {Frenzy} for a duration.

eq5s-18.name: Potency
description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

eq5s-15.name: Tremors
description: Earthquake can cast more minimum possible Aftershocks. Each enemy can only be targeted by one Aftershock.

eq5s-23.name: The Harder They Fall
stats: +15% Initial Slam Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses
description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more hit damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

eq5s-11.name: Upheaval
description: Aftershocks are now damage over time, dealing their normal hit damage each second. Aftershocks last 3 seconds.

eq5s-21.name: Seismic Tide
description:
Earthquake's initial slam occurs three times. First with 30% reduced radius and damage, then with 5% reduced radius and damage, then with 30% increased radius and damage.

Earthquake now has a cooldown, and each initial hit consumes mana.

eq5s-5.name: Shattered Earth
description: Aftershocks have a chance when they hit to cast another Aftershock. Maximum of one additional Aftershock.

eq5s-34.name: Shatterquake
description:
